Game composite probe 320,300: cube result (153,154,147) a D3, final (27,33,24). Water brightens with distance: near (15,18,12), far-ish band (38,42,29). Cube/reflection draws are unfogged; the final composite is fogged (A0A0A0, 2/-1), the same as M05. Editor audit19: near water (44,49,40), 2.5-3x too bright; no distance gradient (far band 31-44). the near-water excess cannot be fog (fog only brightens with distance), so it is a separate composite/light gap. A cube of ~153 with a final of 27 implies a much smaller reflection weight or light term in BD than in M05. The missing far gradient matches the editor's fog distance being taken from the orbit target (see fog-coefficients-linear-mapping). Side finding: the editor shows a Base War building at the start point that the TeamDestruction game does not draw; editor objects need filtering by game type. Composite decode (audit #3, draw 3245196, bdw3 trace line 5892, same program as M05): light R0 = V0*T2.a + T2.rgb; refl = 2*T0.rgb*R0, where T0 = the reflection-pass frame, (153,154,147) a D3; out = lerp(T1 tint/scene term, refl, T0.a'); then fog. V0 at the first vertex = (0.073,0.061,0.043), a 0.5 (vs M05 0.114,0.091,0.068). The ground map T2 is not sampled in the trace. Final (27,33,24) = (0.105,0.13,0.094) implies a total light L ~0.09-0.11 (assuming T0.a' ~0.8-0.9 and a small T1 term). The editor's (44,49,40) is equivalent to L ~0.3, so the editor's water light term is ~3x too large at BD. Inference from first-vertex values, not a per-pixel read. Fog on the composite draw itself (PRG header, tex 80230000, fin 130C0300): colour A6BBBA, coefficients 2.63636/-0.0018182, so f = 1.636 - 0.001818*d, i.e. clear up to d ~350 m and fully fogged at ~900 m (per level; M05 is 2/-1). Near the start f = 1, so the composite is unfogged, which matches the final (27,33,24) sitting far below the fog colour. Pass 13 follow-up (editor audit21/22, pose 713,1372,15,225,5, fog from the eye): BD fog starts at 350 m, so this water is unfogged and fog is not the cause. Editor near water (45,48,40) vs game (27,33,24) = 1.65x (not 2.5-3x). Editor far (32,36,30) gets darker with distance while the game brightens. Editor near stages: cube (133,132,146), w = f*sat(4a) = 0.86, lit = (0.18,0.19,0.15) = ambient term 0.14 (lightmap r 1.0) + sun term 0.05 (gm.a 0.67). The game needs L ~(0.10,0.125,0.095) given cube 0.6 and w 0.86, which is about the editor's ambient term alone x0.88. So in the game either the sun term is ~0 here or G.rgb is lower than amb*gm.r. Unproven: the pose is uncertain and T2/T0.a' are unread. A scratch runtime stage-probe (T0-T3, C0/C1, V0/V1, fog factor at a pixel) is being built by pass 13. Stage probe (audit #3, draw 4252920, prog 00421, fin 130C0300, fog A6BBBA 2.636/-0.001818): pixel before = E7B1B0B4 (reflection-pass rgb (177,176,180), fresnel alpha E7 = 0.906); after = (25,29,22). V0 = (0.0732,0.0613,0.0429, a 0.5). BD stage-0 constants: deep C0 = (0.392,0.478,0.396, a 0.247), shallow C1 = (0.537,0.537,0.380, a 0.247), which differ from M05's 647A65/898961. The probe's T2 ground-map sample (0 at uv 0.00786,0.052) is suspect, and stageprobe2 applies uv*size twice on fmt-12 rect textures, so T0/T1 and T0.a' are unknown. with refl ~0.69 and w ~0.9, an output of ~0.1 needs L ~0.08. Stageprobe3 (2C69D882, rect-uv fix; composite draw 3488768): pixel DF9D9CA2 -> (17,19,12), fog factor 1.611 (unfogged). T0 640x480 fmt 12 texel (320,300) = rgba 0 (the frame copy is 0 at this pixel at this draw). T1 320x240 = (0.0346,0.0294,0.0254, a 0). T2 ground map 512x512: the water quad's real vertex uvs are (0.012,0.047), (-0.036,0.095), (-0.036,0.047), so it samples the empty corner/edge of the ground light map window and reads 0. This is not a probe bug. So in the game, L = V0*G.a + G.rgb ~ 0 on this water: no ground-map ambient and no sun term. The editor's ambient term 0.14 (lightmap r = 1.0) is therefore the likely main excess. with L ~0 the traced output (17,19,12) is not fully explained by the decoded stages (the T1 tint term alone is ~(5,4,2)), so one stage label or input is still off. Mismatch resolved (audit #3 rcdec of bdsp3 draw 3488768): s0 R0 = T1.a*C0 + C1*(1-T1.a); s1 T1.rgb = R0*T1.rgb; s2 R0 = V0*T2.a + T2.rgb (= 0 with T2 = 0); s3 T0.rgb = 2*T0*R0 (= 0); s3a T0.a = T0.a*R1.a, where R1.a reduces to T1.a (x4) = 0; s4 R0 = T0.a*T0.rgb + (1-T0.a)*T1.rgb = T1.rgb. Fog clamps to 1. So here out = C1.rgb x T1.rgb (shallow tint x the half-res scene/refraction copy), with T1.a ~0. Both the reflection/FB term (T0, DF9D9CA2) and the ground light drop out entirely. Backing out (17,19,12) gives T1.rgb ~(0.124,0.139,0.124) = (32,35,32), not the probed (0.035,0.029,0.025). The probe's T1 fetch (320x240 fmt 12 at 8004D000, read 00090807) is likely stale guest memory read before the copy resolves. Unverified: the exact T1 value. Editor implication: the editor's w = 0.86 here is wrong. In the game the reflection weight is T0.a x thickness-alpha, and the thickness alpha (T1.a, from the scene copy's alpha) is 0 at this BD pixel. So the BD near water should show no reflection at all. Pass 14 (stageprobe3, human at 705,1380, probe 320,300): the 512x512 ground light map (surface 80C18000) is 0 at this pixel for BOTH the water composite (draw 3488768, T2 uv (0.00775,0.04992); all 3 vertices within 0.05 of the map corner) and the terrain draw under it (draw 3488543, T3 uv (0.01045,0.05459)). T0 (the frame copy) reads 0 because the copy is not in guest memory, so T0.a' is unobtainable. Conflict: pass 14 attributes the final (17,19,12) to T1 = (0.035,0.029,0.025) refraction, while audit #3's decode (out = C1 x T1) backs out T1 ~(0.124,0.139,0.124) and calls the probed T1 stale. Unresolved. since terrain AND water both read G = 0 near the camera, this is a window placement/edge effect, not unlit water. It fits a frustum-placed window (ground-lightmap-is-camera-window: ~2 km at ~4 m/px) whose near edge sits at the camera, with cleared border texels. uv 0.01-0.05 is ~20-100 m inside the corner. The editor samples the baked lightmap by world position and does not model the window, so it lights this near ground and water while the game does not. Probe tool (for the record): stageprobe3 (2C69D882) fetches all stages through rc_stage_fetch (stage mode, q divide, filtering), and rect (fmt 12) textures are no longer scaled by size twice. M05 cross-check (audit #3 stageprobe3, Mission_05copy post-teleport ~(1801,244), probe 200,350; composite draw 5621161, prog 00421, fin 130C0300, fog A0A0A0 2/-1): fog factor 0.758, pixel E8878793 -> (83,80,79), V0 (0.1145,0.0907,0.068, a 0.5). T2 samples the ground map INSIDE its window (tc (0.928,0.766), texel 475,392) and still reads 0. The probed T1 (0.0165,0.025,0.0306) x C1 gives ~3 levels vs the observed 80. Conclusion: the stage probe cannot read GPU-generated render-target textures (the frame/scene copy and the per-frame ground light map); they are stale or unsynced in guest memory. So the BD G = 0 and T1 reads are most likely probe artifacts, not game behaviour. The BD no-light / no-reflection claims stay UNCONFIRMED and are probably wrong. PROBE-UNVERIFIED: stageprobe2/3 reads of render-target textures come from stale guest memory, because the real draws run on the native GPU. [shortened in the public copy]
facts.how_to_use: Editor water: the reflection weight = fresnel x 4*thickness alpha, where thickness alpha ~0.09-0.10 at BD near water and 0.165 at the M05 probe. Fit the depth -> alpha mapping before tuning the light (the light is already slightly low).

facts.title: M15 WallVent pair: one vent is flat ambient because its instance is yawed ~184 deg (normals face away from the sun)
facts.fact: Pass 19 R2-20 (stageprobe7 dumps). Vent A = WallVent uid 194093 (708.78,180,499.51; draws 4290555/4290831/4290847): V0 = ambient exactly. Vent B = WallVent uid 116395 (708.12,156.24,499.55; draws 4290556/4290830/4290846): V0 varies per vertex. Both draws run the identical vertex program with identical c12-c15 (c12 amb 0.1059/0.0784/0.0863, c13 dir (-0.317,-0.560,0.766), c14 sun 0.392/0.318/0.235, c15 (1,1,1,0.5)); only c4.c7 differ: B c4=(0.9976,0,0.0698) (yaw ~4 deg), A c4=(-0.9976,0,-0.0698) (yaw ~184 deg). c4.c6 are matrix COLUMNS: world n = n.x*c4 + n.y*c5 + n.z*c6. Check, vtx 12 (n length 0.121, normalised (0.137,0.671,-0.728)): B N.L = 0.984, predicted V0.r 0.4918 vs dump 0.4919; A N.L = -0.233, clamps to 0, so ambient. B's per-vertex spread comes from the grille's own normals (vtx 14 N.L small, V0 0.130). No per-instance flag. Pass 18's labels for the two vents were swapped.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: rotate normals by the instance matrix (columns c4.c6) before N.L, normalise, clamp at 0. A flat ambient vent means its rotation is right.

facts.title: M15 facade draw 4792724: full V0 formula, constant-alpha blend, env-mapped reflective material; instance identity unknown (parked)
facts.fact: Full model V0 = c1*(c15*c12 + c0 + max(N.L,0)*c15*c14) + c16; in this draw c0 (self-illum slot) = 0, c16 = 0, c1 = 1. UV0 = v2*c3.x (1/1024); a second UV set comes from v3. Facade: c7 = (380.254,157,367.77), c4 = (-0.788,0,-0.616), c15 = (0.262745,0.266667,0.274510,0.075) exactly, tex0 0x81048000 128x128 fmt 0F. Vertices 0-2 share one normal (0,-0.149,0.988): N.L 0.706, V0 (0.1006,0.0808,0.0693,0.075), matching on all channels. At the traced pixel (200,60), V0 = c15*c12 = (0.0278,0.0209,0.0237): ambient only. Blend is on with 0x8003/0x8004 eq 0x8006 = CONSTANT_ALPHA / ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_ALPHA (the constant is not logged), so V0.a 0.075 does not drive the blend. Alpha test off, z test on, z write off. 5 combiner stages: t0 diffuse 81048000; t1 80859000 fmt 0C on uv2; t2 80A07000 32x32 cube env (VS instructions 28-34 reflect about the eye at c17). c7 is shared by 7 draws (around 4792723-4792726; other t0 81059000 / 81020000, t1 807FD000): one instance, several submeshes. Pass 20: the editor shading formula matches; the editor forces alpha 1 for non-blend materials, a candidate part of the 3.3x gap. Nothing in M15ocopy.ma2map lies within 40 m of c7, so it is not a plain world object.
facts.how_to_use: To resume: match t0 0x81048000 to a texture name through the texture fingerprint, or log the blend constant in a new trace.

facts.title: Art pipeline: models and animation authored in 3ds Max 4.2/5, exported with RAD Granny 3D; static meshes in Day 1's own .mgmodel

facts.title: MACorporeal orientation: R = Ry(heading) * Rx(pitch) * Rz(roll), degrees; +pitch tips +Z down, +roll tips +X up
facts.fact: Placed objects carry CorporalHeading / CorporalPitch / CorporalRoll in degrees (every MACorporeal, 22,338 records; ~2,800 retail objects have non-zero pitch or roll: leaning trees 15-35, rocks, cliffs, wall vents roll +-90, searchlights pitch 60/90; per editor-ux). The game's world matrix (model VS c4.c6 = columns, c7 = position) equals Ry(h)*Rx(p)*Rz(r) with column vectors and standard right-handed matrices: Ry(h) maps local +Z to (sin h,0,cos h); Rx(p) maps +Z to (0,-sin p,cos p), so positive pitch tips the +Z end DOWN; Rz(r) maps +X to (cos r,sin r,0), so positive roll tips the +X end UP. Heading is used unwrapped (770, 1542 occur). Verified against existing stageprobe traces: IYF Env_CityTree_02 (854.74,36,1274.66) h810 r15 -> X column (0,0.259,-0.966); KF Env_Hesperus_Rock (565.63,63,1495.89) p25 -> Z column (0,-0.423,0.906); order fit over 5 objects with pitch and roll both non-zero (UnderCover x3, KillingField h15 p150 r75, Mission_15 h770 p180 r-90): YXZ max error < 0.001, every other order >= 0.77. Editor-ux also found that MAWater has no scale property; water size is the model bbox (250/500/1000 tiles), so free water scaling is impossible in the format. Round-trip verified in game (editor-ux 2026-10-23): BldCom_TER_Tower_02_MP tilted in the editor (pitch ~-48, roll ~-25), saved, played in PC Release; the tower leans as expected (round-1023/ux2/45-game-tilted-tower.png).
facts.how_to_use: Editor/tools: build object matrices as Ry*Rx*Rz from the three degree properties. Don't offer a water scale handle; offer the 250/500/1000 tile models.

facts.title: Editor palette sweep gaps (2026-10-23):road pieces are template-less; greedy category filters hid SearchLights, Heavy Bomb and Cinema mechs; 3 boss classes were unlisted
facts.fact: Why .road was missing: the palette is built only from GlobalEntities templates (3,449). MARoad has 0 templates: each road piece is a world-only object whose RoadDefinition string names a .road file (966 pieces in 18 worlds, 872 with TemplateID 0). There are 16 .road files on disc (13 roads/country/*, 3 roads/runway/*), plus env_widebridge01_sectiontwo.road, which no world references. Placing writes MARoad (RoadDefinition, RoadPosition, RoadRotation yaw) under MAGroup 'Placed Roads' > MARoadGroup; the save ships the .road, its _rw.node model and textures to [Assets]. Verified in game (Mission_05 base, 3 pieces). Substring category filters hid: Turrets/SearchLights (4 templates, 8 uses in Mission_03/04; 'Lights' matched), Weapons/Vehicles/VTOL Bombs 'Heavy Bomb' (MAPowerUp, 34 uses in 14 MP maps; 'Weapons'), Mechs/Cinema Versions ('Cinema'). MAMiniSpider (42 uses, Mission_15/WitchCauldron), MASpider (Mission_08) and MAUberBoss (Mission_17b) were not in the placeable list; now under Mechs/Bosses. Not offerable: retail instances with TemplateID 0 (MACorporeal 44, MABuilding 11, MATurret 5, MAMech 2, MAPerson 2, MAFlyer 1, MAVehicle 1) and MACorporeal template 36714 (5 uses in 6 MP maps), which is not in GlobalEntities; they only come with a retail copy. By design: mode-kit objects (MACheckpoint etc.), effects/triggers (MACollectionArea, MAEffect oil fire), MAGroup prefabs and engine-managed classes. Road snapping:road [attachments] stores nPoints plus point/vector pairs explicitly (entry (0,0,0) vector (0,0,+1)). straight15xroot2 (21.213) and straight15xroot2over2 (10.606) are straights, not diagonals; up10deg/down10deg exit at (0,0,-60) like longStraight. The exit table is in the MARoad catalog entry.
facts.how_to_use: Palette code: list template-less placeable classes (MARoad from the .road file list) separately from templates; match categories by path segment, not substring.

facts.title: MAEnvironment weather fields: reader, object offsets, and how rain/precipitation spawns
facts.fact: The MAEnvironment reader is sub_00124CC1 (runs on this+0x20); the ctor is sub_00123173. Object offsets: EnableRain 0x11C, EnableLightning 0x11D, PrecipEffectID 0x148, ThunderCueID 0x174, MaxFlashes 0x178, FlashTimeMax 0x17C, FlashTimeMin 0x180, SkyFlash 0x18C, LightFlash 0x18D, LightningColor B/G/R 0x18E/0x18F/0x190, IsNightTime 0x1C4. In the update sub_00126060: if EnableRain is set and the effect isn't active, sub_0012693E spawns template PrecipEffectID (via sub_00161D77) following the camera; if EnableRain is cleared while it is active, sub_001269FC removes it. PrecipEffectID 0 = no precipitation. The disc has only two precipitation templates: 31780 Env_Snow_Blowing and 31516 Env_DustStorm_Wst. No rain asset exists (ids 741/903 used by old editor presets don't exist).
facts.how_to_use: Editor weather: offer Snow (31780) and Dust storm (31516) only; 'rain' needs a custom effect.

facts.title: Lightning is the LightFlash path (EnableLightning is never read); IsNightTime switches lamps and windows but doesn't darken the world
facts.fact: Lightning runs through the LightFlash path (sub_001263F8 / sub_001262A2 / sub_0012612E): random bursts toggle a light at +0x358 and play ThunderCueID if non-zero (it is 0 in every retail world). EnableLightning is never read; only the trigger action sub_00130DBA sets it. IsNightTime does not darken the world (Mission_06a, with a warm sun, has it set to 1; Mission_12, a dark city, has 0); it switches window/lamp light objects. Darkness comes from the ambient/sun/fog colours, the sky model and the env map. CORRECTION 2026-10-24: sub_00130DBA is MAEnvState's per-frame lightning applier, not a trigger action; IsNightTime switches MABuilding light groups, not lamps (see isnighttime-buildings-only).

facts.fact: The game reads %LOCALAPPDATA%\MechAssault2\pc_settings.ini (pc_storage.c ma2_pc_settings_path), not the copy beside the exe. facts.title: Sky-dome fog is per vertex: factor = 1 - q, q = 4.47 - 10 x model_y; the MASky SkyFogTop/Bottom mapping is OPEN
facts.fact: The game fogs sky meshes per vertex: factor = 1 - q with q = 4.47 - 10 x model_y (fog coefficients '2 -1'). The horizon band y < 0.347 is fully fog colour and clears by y = 0.447. In that world MASky SkyFogTop = 1500 and SkyFogBottom = 500. OPEN: how SkyFogTop/Bottom and SkyTerrainSkyScale/Offset map to q. MASky2 code near loc_0012AA4F divides by MEMF(sky+0x1BC) (scale?) and passes MEMF(sky+0x1C4) and MEMF(sky+0x1C8) as two floats to sub_00082340, probably the fog range setter. Catalog offsets (SkyFogTop 452 = 0x1C4, SkyFogBottom 424 = 0x1A8) may be serializer-relative (+0x20), so the pair isn't confirmed. RESOLVED 2026-10-24: see sky-fog-band-setter and sky-fog-q-explained.
facts.how_to_use: To close it: test q = k*(h - Bottom)/(Top - Bottom) with h = y*SkyTerrainSkyScale + offset.y on existing traces, or decode sub_00082340.

facts.fact: MAEnvironment LightFlash=1 with FlashTimeMax == FlashTimeMin (e.g. 1000/1000) kills the game with 0xC0000094 (integer divide by zero) about 10 s into the level. 1000/2000 runs fine. Editor now forces max > min.
facts.how_to_use: Validate FlashTimeMax > FlashTimeMin in the editor.

facts.title: LightFlash lights only dynamic objects
facts.fact: The LightFlash flash is a light that only lights dynamic objects (mechs, pilot); lightmapped terrain and sky show no visible change (frame diff; sky part moderate confidence, shots ~0.3 s apart).
facts.how_to_use: Do not expect lightning to flash the terrain.

facts.title: Scenario [Assets] cache key hashes the path list only
facts.fact: ma2_scenario.c build_resource hashes only the archive|path list + base, not file contents. Fine for retail copies. The earlier 'rain stall' was misdiagnosed: the game was running (kernel calls rising, pilot walks); screenshots just looked frozen.
facts.how_to_use: Changing embedded file contents without changing the path list may reuse a stale cache.

facts.title: MATerrain heights are 8-bit steps; low ground can hide under water
facts.fact: MATerrain heights are 8-bit lround steps of (TerrainMax-TerrainMin)/255 (0.47 m at -20.100). A pond tool lifting ground to water+0.2 m could save below the water, so the 250 m water tile showed through as a dark wavy sheet. Ground 0.3 m over a Water_250_250 NEW surface hides it fully (Bogged Down test).
facts.how_to_use: Keep ground at least 0.3 m above water when hiding the water tile; account for quantization step when saving.

facts.title: Survey of material_specular_mask across all MGMODELs
facts.fact: 1,328 material_specular_mask entries in all .MGMODEL. shininess is almost always 0; shin_strength ranges 0.1 (125 entries at 1.0, 101 at 0.0, 97 at 0.8); 381 have _spclr in the material name, 947 don't. Env_Water_250_250 = material_water deep 100,122,101, shallow 137,137,97, fresnel 0.77.1, wave Water_006_NewWater.
facts.how_to_use: The _spclr suffix is not required for specular_mask materials.

facts.title: SPECULAR_MASK stage gating: detailtexture slot, no shin_strength threshold
facts.fact: Parse sub_0004DB80 (vtable 0x45E710 slot 6; name getter 0x4DAC0) reads basetexture into mat+0x68 and detailtexture into mat+0x6C; detail_blend/detail_blend_level are read only if detailtexture loaded (default modulate2x). Instance ctor sub_00073340 loads inst+0x2C/+0x30 only for non-null slots and picks the program set from the mat+0x98 string: empty -> no-detail set (0x4A5480/0x4A5C00/0x4A5840); additive2x -> 0x4A5660/. alphablend -> 0x4A5750/. else 0x4A5570/. Setup 0x736B0 binds stage0=base, stage1=detail if non-null and never binds a cube. No shin_strength threshold found: a material without a detail/mask texture (likely the lightpost) gets the plain program. Spec constant = spec_color/255 x shin_strength (0x4DD90, 0x4DE70, only if shin_strength present), uploaded as PS c0 (a=specular_bloom); detail_blend_level -> c1.a. Shininess is not read here. Unknown: where the cube binds and where the 64x64 mask name comes from (loader sub_00069D70; check string at 0x45E541).
facts.how_to_use: Editor: draw the spec stage only when the material resolves a mask texture; otherwise plain base+lightmap. Treat spec_color x shin_strength as c0.

facts.title: MASky2 entity offsets and reader
facts.fact: Sky class is MASky2. Entity offsets (slice+0x20): SkyTerrainSkyOffset vec3 +0x1AC, SkyTerrainSkyScale vec3 +0x1B8 (+0x1BC = Scale.y), SkyFogTop +0x1C4, SkyFogBottom +0x1C8; catalog 420/424 are slice offsets. Reader sub_0012AA21 (esi=entity) called only from camera updates sub_0011CFA5 and sub_0011DD64; returns early if model at +0x94 is null.
facts.how_to_use: Use entity offsets for runtime reads.

facts.title: Sky dome position formula
facts.fact: V = P + Offset*(10000/Scale.y); K at 0x493B9C is 10000.0 (bytes 00 40 1C 46). P is a caller vector at ebp-12.-4, probably the camera (inferred). V goes to model vtable +0x30/+0x38.

facts.title: SkyFogTop/Bottom passed to render singleton vtable +0x144
facts.fact: SkyFogTop/Bottom are passed (Top,Bottom) to vtable +0x144 of the object at [[sub_00161B4B+0x18]+8] (probably render/device singleton, global 0x50C958); that method makes the per-vertex sky fog constants and is unidentified. clue sub_00082340 was wrong (takes no floats). q = 4.47 - 10*model_y still not derived (simple linear maps of Top/Bottom/Scale.y/Offset.y fail). MAEnvState sub_00130290 also reads FogTop/Bottom/FogOn.
facts.how_to_use: Open: identify the +0x144 target, or trace its two floats and the VS constants in game.

facts.title: MAActionActivateCinema start
facts.fact: Execute (vtable 0x475600 slot 22, 00156AD8) reads cinema UID at action +0x60, resolves via sub_000B4F70, calls MACinema Start sub_00155A99: no-op if byte 0x4EB19C already set; else 0x4EB198=cinema, 0x4EB19C=1, time +0x7C=0, finds child group Camera Controllers, index +0x8C=0, starts first controller via slot +0xB8 (sub_001565B5). If 0x50C85C==0 sets byte +0x42=1 on singleton sub_00161B4B (input lock, inferred). Only one cinema at a time.

facts.title: Readers of the cinema-active byte
facts.fact: 0x4EB19C is tested by SP HUD update sub_001F77DB (gates sub_0024585B), MACorporeal sub_000DBBCA, MAProjectile sub_000EE7FD, MAPowerUp sub_00131957, sub_0015D499, sub_000C864D. No letterbox renderer found. What each skips is inferred.

facts.title: Cinema shot advance and stop
facts.fact: Advance = slot +0x1C (sub_001559A0): advances controller (sub_0015649A), ++ +0x8C, Stop when none remain. Stop sub_00155B53 clears +0x78, calls slot +0xC0(1) on controllers, clears 0x4EB198/0x4EB19C; if 0x50C85C==0 and flag arg set, writes double 0x4A14F0=1.0 (game time scale, inferred). Level unload sub_000171E0 force-stops; slot 13 (sub_001558DA) also clears flag. Open: skip-button caller, meaning of 0x50C85C, bSkipTo effect, MAFreeCamera interpolation.

facts.title: Camera FOV and shot length fields
facts.fact: FOV = MAFreeCamera CameraFOV (read sub_0011DBFF @0011DC9D, written @0011DADB), near/far planes beside it. Shot length = MAFreeCameraController CameraDuration (F428FDE8) seconds, default 8, retail 0.75-45. MACameraPan has no time/FOV; heading/pitch/speed/LockTarget/look-at/DoSpline at +0x110/+0x114/+0x118/+0x13C/+0x140/+0x160 (accessors 001220AC, 00121ED1; pan update not found; meanings inferred). Catalog: MACameraProperty Offset read_site 0x1384D8 actually belongs to MAModSubObjectParticleEffect.

facts.title: Trigger Test flags are vehicle-struct bits
facts.fact: Six Test flags are bits of one byte, not MATrigger fields: Avatar 0x01 (EE2488E6), Tank 0x02 (F2DFE7F8), Turret 0x04 (31B185EC), VTOL 0x08 (53E3A880), BattleArmor 0x10 (0DC7125D), Mech 0x20 (F46078C6). Struct at runtime +0x100 in MATriggerRadius (flag byte +0x104) and +0x13C in MATriggerCuboid. Serializer sub_001991FD from sub_00146055 and sub_00147BD7. Key-to-bit pairing not individually re-checked.
facts.how_to_use: Catalog: move these keys from owner MATrigger to Radius/Cuboid.

facts.title: CheckVehicleType gate
facts.fact: Test bits apply only when CheckVehicleType is on (Radius runtime +0xF6, slice 0xD6). Off: every unit counts. On: unit counts only if (type bits & flag byte)!=0, so all six clear = trigger can never fire. Helper sub_0019955F. TypeOfCheck at +0xC4 (switch in sub_001467B1). CORRECTION 2026-10-24: TypeOfCheck is a dword enum at +0xE4, not +0xC4 (see trigger-typeofcheck-offset).
facts.how_to_use: Editor should warn when CheckVehicleType=1 and no Test bit set.

facts.title: MATrigger runtime offsets
facts.fact: Runtime = slice+0x20 (TriggerEnabled slice 0x69 -> +0x89). AllowClientActivate +0x8A, MissionVariable +0x90 (ctor sub_00144B26 sets -1), UseRndReset +0x9D, RndResetTimeMin/Max +0xA0/+0xA4, ResetIfHaveInvalidCheck +0xAC. In update sub_001467B1 a fired trigger exits unless +0xAC set (then re-tests). Radius ResetIfHaveInvalidRadiusCheck copies into +0xAC only when nonzero. No consumers found for random-reset floats, MissionVariable, AllowClientActivate. CONTRADICTS catalog tooltip that ResetIfHaveInvalidCheck is off in every retail trigger: slice shows 64 of 394 Radius instances with 1; re-check which key.

facts.title: Culture level sampling
facts.fact: tx=floor(W*x/(Ta*S)), tz=floor(H*z/(Tb*S)); W,H culture map size, Ta/Tb terrain tile counts, S tile size; out-of-map skipped. texel=u16 map[tz*W+tx]; level=((texel&mask)>>shift)/(2^NBits-1) via MACultureType+0x84 cultureBF (NBits +0xC, mask +0x10, shift +0x14). No descriptor -> level 0 -> cell skipped. Functions sub_0018045F, sub_00189E62, sub_001899C6, sub_002674A0. Name->cultureBF link inferred.

facts.title: Culture grid and count per cell
facts.fact: Grid is GridScale only if SnapToGrid (gen+0x82)=1; all 46 retail generators have 0, so cell = one culture texel (Ta*S/W, Tb*S/H), no offset/angle. f=cellArea*Density*level*1e-6 (const 0x4541EC); count=floor(f)+(rand01<frac(f)); snapped grids clamp count to 1. Corrects culture-system-layout (GridScale is NOT the grid).

facts.title: Culture RNG seed and per-attempt order
facts.fact: RNG state gen+0x1D4, reseeded per cell with (cx<<16)^gen[+0x2C]^cz (sub_0001DA00). Per attempt: unsnapped x then y jitter rand(0.001,0.999) (snapped: corner+0.001, no draw); slope=acos(N.y) deg (sub_001804C3) must be in [MinSlope,MaxSlope]; NearestNeighbor test (sub_00180518, untraced); yaw rand(0,[0x50F4EC]) only if RandomRotation (+0x81); scale 1+rand(-R,R) R=+0x84 always; AlignWithSlope (+0x80) sets up=normal; instance from GenerationTemplate (+0x78) via sub_001805FE. Generation radius = StopFade(+0x94)+largest cell (inferred). RNG internals untraced.
facts.how_to_use: Editor (app_culture.cpp): texel cells, corner+0.001 snap, jitter [0.001,0.999), count rule above.

facts.title: MAEnvState starts itself; six channel appliers
facts.fact: No MAAction activates MAEnvState; retail places none. Ctor sub_0012F5AE sets active +0x80=1, pending +0x81=1 so a placed instance self-starts. Update vtable slot 7 sub_001308FC waits TimeToTransition (+0x78; deadline +0x7C), then runs appliers fog sub_001309CD, ambient sub_00130C19, sun sub_00130CBB, weather sub_00130D60, lightning sub_00130DBA, sky sub_00130B4E, each via sub_00130E06(cur,target,rate) moving by rate*dt (double 0x4E2428), clamped; +0x80 clears when all done.

facts.title: MAEnvState rates and zero-duration guard
facts.fact: rate=|target-current|/fade (sub_00130E72); setters sub_0012F7B6 ambient, 0012F853 sun, 0012F8F3 fog, 0012FA4E sky, 0012FB32 weather, 0012FB65 lightning. sub_00130E72 returns 0 when SkyFogChangeDuration (+0x10C)==0, which zeroes every rate so the transition never finishes (inferred).
facts.how_to_use: Editor writing MAEnvState must give SkyFogChangeDuration>0.

facts.title: MAEnvState runtime field map
facts.fact: TransitionTime +0x78; Ambient colour +0x84/fade +0xA0; Sun +0xA4/+0xC0; FogOn +0xC4 (alias of FogMode)/FogFade +0xC8; SkyFogColour +0x110, Start/End +0x12C/+0x134, Fade +0x10C; WeatherOn +0x13C -> MAEnvironment EnableRain +0x11C, fade +0x140, strength +0x144; LightningOn +0x14C -> env EnableLightning +0x11D, fade +0x150, strength +0x154. Sky fog on +0x108 never read by an applier. Flash functions sub_001263F8/001262A2/0012612E do not read lerped strength (lightning never read still holds). Open: caller of slot-16 copy sub_00130EB0; whether setters run in ctor or update.

facts.title: IsNightTime only switches MABuilding light groups
facts.fact: IsNightTime is a bool at env runtime +0x1C4 (name string 0x46DD00). Sole consumer MABuilding light update sub_00127ED7 (vtable 0x46E3E8 slot 11): reads g_env [0x4EAFE4] and switches light-group node at building +0x2B8 via sub_0011E595->sub_00082020. Lamps (MACorporeal) and MAPointLight do not read it. Corrects the earlier claim that it switches lamps. Only other reader: env copy sub_001265CB.
facts.how_to_use: Editor night toggle: building LIGHTS groups only; lamp posts need another path (unknown).

facts.title: sub_00082020 node enable setter
facts.fact: sub_00082020 (edi=node, cl=bool) sets requested-state bit 1 of node +0x34; on change updates effective bit 2 and recurses into children (sub_00081F80/00081FD0) so a child is active only when ancestors are. Shared by building lights and MAActionLights. Bit names inferred.

facts.title: MAActionLights behaviour by member class
facts.fact: Execute vtable 0x473CC0 slot 22 (sub_0014E063); LightSet UID +0x64 (default 0, no-op), LightAction +0x68 (default 3); members go to sub_0014E0B6. MAPointLight (class id 0x4EB004): 0 on,1 off,2 on,3 off (writes LightOn +0x90, vtable +0x90 on light +0xA4). MACorporeal subclasses (0x4EAF2C): flags +0x80: 0 clears 0x10, 1 sets 0x10, 2 sets 0x20, 3 clears 0x20; on=(0x20&&!0x10). Corporeal flags reach a node only for MABuilding (0x4EAFFC): sub_000D81DA fills +0xDC with model child LIGHTS (string 0x4673FC), sub_000DF53E applies it. The lamp lightbulb subtree is not driven by any traced path (lightbulb is not an XBE string; likely .mtb data via MAModSubObjectShow). The earlier 2=on,3=off dispatch is right for point lights only.
facts.how_to_use: Open: is lightbulb a child of LIGHTS; retail LightSet member classes.

facts.title: Cube faces upload in stored D3D order
facts.fact: PC NV2A layer uploads cube faces in stored order: face k at k*stride (one face with all mips, rounded up to 128 bytes). Sampling is standard D3D major-axis: +X=0,-X=1,+Y=2,-Y=3,+Z=4,-Z=5; neither recomp nor CPU rasteriser reorders or flips. Agrees with cube-face-order. On-disc face order inferred to be D3D order (not checked against an extracted env map). Files: kit/source/game/src/kernel/nv2a_gpu_d3d11.c 1400-1521, nv2a_gpu.hlsl 150-161, nv2a_pb_exec.c 1733-1820.
facts.how_to_use: Extract EnvMap_Sky_CityNight to confirm disc order.

facts.title: Z2WLookup depth LUT for water
facts.fact: sub_000541B0 creates Z2WLookup0 (256x64, ptr 0x50C72C, copy 0x50C730) and PrecisionLookup (1024x1, 0x50C734); sub_00056960 fills them. u=x/(W-1), v=y/(H-1), t=(u*65280+v*255)/65535 (16-bit normalised depth); texel=clamp(-P1/(192*(P0-t)),0,1), 16-bit high byte first, swizzled: z-buffer depth -> view distance/192, saturating at 192 m (0x493CC4=1/192, 0x493CC8=65280). P0=[0x524AD0]+0x23E0 and P1=+0x23F0 are projection terms (stored by sub_0003AE40; sub_00055150 caches at 0x4A23D8/DC, regenerates on change; mode byte 0x50C720 selects path, switch at 0x548D0 in sub_000547F0). CONFLICT: t15 says a=sat(8*(sceneDepth-waterDepth)+V0.a^2) and t12 says sat(vertical depth/4); neither uses the 1/192 scale, so the thickness combiner needs a trace. Open: P0/P1 at run time, PrecisionLookup fill path, consumer shader. UPDATE 2026-10-24: thickness conflict resolved in favour of t15 form (see water-z2w-meaning). UPDATE 2026-10-24: PrecisionLookup fill path is a linear 16-bit ramp (water-precision-lookup-ramp).

facts.title: NationTypeToTest on MATriggerMenuActivate is live
facts.fact: NationTypeToTest is an int at entity +0xE4 (serializer +0xC4) and is used; inert-property-keys and the catalog no effect note are wrong. Test at 0x14A2B2: if flag bit 0x10 (UseNationCorporeal, flags +0xEC) set compare the nation of the corporeal whose UID is at +0xE0, else compare +0xE4; bit 0x08 TestInverseNation inverts. Update slot (vtable 0x473480 +0x1C, sub_0014A415) calls it at 0x14A56D over a unit list. All 75 retail uses = 1. Flag word +0xEC: 0x1 DisplayText, 0x2 PilotOnly, 0x4 TestNationType, 0x8 TestInverseNation, 0x10 UseNationCorporeal, 0x20 UseJackingInterface, 0x80 AllowExitWithoutFailure (0x08/0x10 code-confirmed, rest from serializer names).
facts.how_to_use: Catalog: remove the no-effect note.

facts.title: CaptureObject and unknown hex keys have no game logic
facts.fact: CaptureObject (MAFlagCTF byte +0x1E4) is read only by its serializer (0x15025F) and slot-16 copy (0x151625): no game-logic effect. The comiss at 0x150E89/0x15182E read +0x1C4 (compared with 2.0) and TimeBetweenPickups (+0x1D4). MoeEntity key 2A68614F and MASpawner keys 369C837B and 4026434E are absent from their serializers (MoeEntity 0xB3540/0xB2CC0; MASpawner read 0x132C92, write 0x13270D) and no immediate of them appears in code; loader ignoring them is inferred (unknown-CRC handling not traced).

facts.title: MASpawner spawn rules
facts.fact: Entity offset = serializer offset+0x20. Init (slot 11, 0x1325B5): NextSpawnTime=now+SpawnDelay(+0x64), skipped if byte +0x12A set. Tick (slot 7, 0x13321F) spawns only if flags +0x58 has 0x01 Enabled and 0x10 clear, NumSpawned(+0x78)<MaxSpawners(+0x5C), NumActive(+0x7C)<MaxActiveSpawners(+0x70), now>NextSpawnTime(+0x74); a cap of 0 skips that check. On spawn NumSpawned++, NumActive++, NextSpawnTime=now+SpawnRate(+0x60), entity index (+0xBC) advances. Flag bits: 0x02 IsAnimated, 0x04 IsGameCritical, 0x08 PickRandomEntity, 0x20 CountJackedAsKilled. Retail: MaxActiveSpawners=1 on 1100/1202; MaxSpawners=0 (unlimited) on 1028, 1 on 80. Seconds as unit inferred. Open: who decrements NumActive (0x157CD0 touches +0x9C), init at 0x1326E3-0x1326F4 writes MaxSpawners=10 (overrides retail 0?), meaning of bit 0x10, PickRandomEntity selection (0x1331CC), Nation 1. UPDATE 2026-10-24: counter offsets +0x98/+0x9C and the 0/0 -> 10 default are in spawner-counters and spawner-default-ten. UPDATE 2026-10-24: use spawner-runtime-offsets for runtime offsets.

facts.title: Highway lamp is a plain MACorporeal
facts.fact: Env_Highway_Light is a plain MACorporeal (Mission_01b UID 130229, CorporalMTB Env_Highway_Light.mtb), not MABuilding, so neither IsNightTime nor MAActionLights reaches its lightbulb subtree (both act only via MABuilding LIGHTS node +0xDC, filled by sub_000D81DA only for class 0x4EAFFC). LightsOn (2973033B)=1 and LightsDisabled=0 in all 22,338 retail instances. Open: what turns the lamp lightbulb/spot/cone on - no code path found; candidates MAModSubObjectShow on a hidden node, or always-on with the .mtb hide flag ignored. Other lamp templates unchecked. UPDATE 2026-10-24:mtb hides the bulb subtree by default (highway-lamp-mtb-hides-bulb).
facts.how_to_use: Next: MAModSubObjectShow Execute; node-parent dump of Env_Highway_Light.mtb.

facts.title: Spot cone angles are half-angles (radians)
facts.fact: SetAngles sub_0006E920 applies fsincos to raw values and stores 1/(cos outer - cos inner) at B+0x90 and an offset at B+0x94. Cone test sub_0006EA10: t=u*B[0x90]+B[0x94]; t<0 black, clamped to 1 above; u=dot(p-L,-dir)/|p-L|, L=light+0x14. Ctor sub_0006E450 defaults inner 0.4, outer 0.7 (0x493BF0/0x493C38). Lit only within range B+0xE4 (default 1.0), falloff starts at B+0xE0. Upgrades node-light-angles-are-half from inferred.

facts.title: Spot cone is centred on -dir
facts.fact: Cone is centred on -dir, dir = stored direction at light+0x28 (orientation matrix row 2, set by sub_0024F4A0). So t12 spot-light-axis (lit side +Z) is probably reversed: if the source matrix is the node world matrix the lamp shines toward node -Z (inferred; caller sub_00038D50 overwrites the SetMatrix argument). node_light min/max colour are RGB bytes at node +0xE8/+0xEC with alpha 0xFF (writer sub_00088260, parser sub_0008B290 vtable 0x4629F4 slot 6); no height-lerp reader found. UPDATE 2026-10-24: -dir claim wrong; see spot-cone-scale-positive. RULING: the code facts describe the RENDER LIGHT's own orientation matrix (direction = row 2, cone centred on -dir) and stand as code. What is NOT proven is that this matrix is the .mtb node's world matrix: the SetMatrix (sub_0006D5B0) caller for node lights was never found. Model geometry plus a same-pose game frame show the beam follows the NODE's local -Y (node-light-spot-beam-direction-is-the-light-nodes-local-minus-y-not-plus-z-geometry-and-game-frame, runtime-observed HIGH). Both hold if the engine applies a basis change from node to light matrix. For editor authoring use node -Y. Editor caveat: it turns light directions by heading only (no pitch/roll; M01b searchlights are pitched 60).
facts.how_to_use: Open: in-game check of which side the pool falls on.

facts.title: AIRange has no consumer; CoolingWaterway is what feeds the AI singleton
facts.fact: AIRange -> float 0x52A8C4 is wrong. sub_001234D6 writes the AI singleton +4 (accessor sub_00018E90, write 0x1236A4) from env +0x1C0, which serializer sub_00124CC1 names CoolingWaterway (0x125787). AIRange is env +0x1A0 (0x125665), used only in load/store round trips (sub_00124CC1, sub_00123746). Nothing reads 0x52A8C4 (negative search). Open: sub_00126440 reads float [esi+0x1A0]; if esi is the env AIRange is live. CORRECTION 2026-10-24: AIRange is read by sub_00126440 as a packed colour channel (see menv-airange-is-colour-channel).

facts.title: How MAEnvironment fog fields reach the renderer
facts.fact: Builder sub_00130290 reads fog by name: FogMode (0x1304CF) enum, setter sub_00126A2A passes 0/1/2 to 0x81350, others -> 0; FogColor (0x13045A) packed 0xAARRGGBB -> vtable +0x12C; FogTop/FogBottom (0x1303C7/0x130403) -> vtable +0x13C, not DrawDistance-scaled; FogStart/FogEnd (0x130334/0x130379) -> vtable +0x134, the DD-scaled hook (re-confirms pc-fog-draw-distance-scale). No FogDensity property exists. Setter displacements: mode 0xF8, colour 0xFC, start/end 0x10C/0x110, band 0x114/0x118. FogMode values 1/2 meaning inferred. DirectionalLightDirection is never read by name (sun direction has no consumer, open). Far plane = MAFreeCamera CameraFarPlane at camera +0x80 (default 475 m); catalog offsets 104/136 disagree.

facts.title: SetSkyFogBand sub_00037500
facts.fact: SkyFogTop (T) and SkyFogBottom (B) go to renderer vtable 0x45C8A0 slot +0x144 = sub_00037500 (SetSkyFogBand). Renderer built by sub_00035C20; +0x12C SetFogColor sub_00037400, +0x134 SetFogRange sub_00037450 (G+0x2440/0x2444). sub_00037500 writes G=[0x524AD0]: +0x2450=T, +0x2454=B, vec4 at +0x2498=(1/(B-T), -T/(B-T), 0, 1) (1.0 at 0x493A60). No guard for T==B (divide by zero). sub_0003B210 uploads the vec4 as a shader constant when render mode G+0x2438==3 (set by slot +0x124 sub_000373D0).

facts.title: Sky vertex fog q = (y-T)/(B-T)
facts.fact: Per-vertex sky fog q=(y-T)/(B-T), fog factor=1-q, y = sky vertex height in world metres. Trace fit q=4.47-10*model_y gives slope 1/(B-T)=-10, intercept 4.47: in model units T=0.447, B=0.347; with retail T=1500, B=500 the same numbers follow if world y=10000*model_y-2970 (10000 = dome scale K at 0x493B9C; -2970 = dome origin height from V=P+Offset*(K/Scale.y)). Fog is full below SkyFogBottom and clear above SkyFogTop. Formula code-confirmed; the y mapping is inferred from the fit. Closes the sky-dome-vertex-fog open item. UPDATE 2026-10-24: dome scale K and c7 mapping in sky-fog-height-q-and-dome-scale.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: sky VS fog clear fraction = clamp((y_world-Bottom)/(Top-Bottom),0,1); clamping in the sky VS unverified.

facts.title: MAEnvState setters run only from slot 11
facts.fact: The six rate setters run only from sub_0012F774, MAEnvState slot-11 override: calls base sub_000C364B , if it succeeds and [[this+4]+0x28]==[0x4EAFEC] (linked object is an MAEnvironment), the setters. Caller of slot 11 not found. sub_00130E72 tests only this+0x10C (SkyFogChangeDuration): 0.0 -> returns 0, else |target-current|/fade (per-channel fade unguarded); all setters pass the MAEnvState object so duration 0 zeroes every rate. Whether 0 rate holds forever or snaps in sub_00130E06 is unverified. +0x80/+0x81 are written only by ctor (both 1) and update (+0x80 cleared): an MAEnvState runs once, nothing re-arms it. UPDATE 2026-10-24: see envstate-setters-run-once and envstate-rate-zero-never-finishes (duration 0 freezes, does not snap).

facts.title: Weather strength globals and 0.15 threshold
facts.fact: Weather applier sub_00130D60 writes lerped strength to MAEnvironment +0x150 and global 0x50C8FC, EnableRain to env +0x11C and global 0x50C8FA; sub_001234D6 and sub_0012693E also write them. Only reader of the globals, sub_001390C5, acts only when 0x50C8FA!=0 and 0x50C8FC>0.15 (0x493C78); that it is the rain emitter is inferred. Weather rate this+0x148, target this+0x144.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: rain needs EnableRain and strength > 0.15.

facts.title: How the game parses .road files
facts.fact: Game reads .road as INI via the mgIO INI reader (opener 0x0025EC80). MARoad vtable slot 11 (0x000D52A3) -> 0x000D5387 -> 0x000D5424 -> 0x000D5508 parses [params] (fWidth, fLength), [boundary] (point1/point2 as three floats) and [attachments] (nPoints then point/vector pairs), then 0x000D5C80 parses [Roads]: nPoints, per node point, flags, type, connect, nConnects. Types PATHNODE_CENTERLINE/SIDEWALK/ROAD (0xD5E97), EXIT/ENTRANCE (0xD5EDD). MARoad keys RoadDefinition, RoadPosition, RoadRotation (0xD591F). Second route 0x000E0161 (.road string) also reaches 0xD5C80, called only from 0x000D7B3D (slot-11 method shared by MACorporeal and MASky2). Section order inferred from call order.
facts.how_to_use: The game reads point1/point2 only from [boundary]; the editor reads them from any section.

facts.title: Roads are drawn at authored height; no runtime terrain conform
facts.fact: Static call graph from the MARoad vtable and parser (703 functions, depth 12) never meets callers of ground-height core 0x002AAA30 (159 functions, depth 8); no z-bias render state or depth-bias string found. Every retail MARoad has ShadowReceiverType 1 (966/966), so roads use the ground light-map pre-pass. Negative search over direct calls only (indirect not followed). Editor road_rest_height (roads.cpp:31-62, 93) samples footprint ~2 m, takes the highest terrain and adds 0.15 m: consistent. Open: depth EQUAL vs LEQUAL. UPDATE 2026-10-24: EQUAL pass answered by road-depth-equal.

facts.title: Road [attachments] look tool-only
facts.fact: Game stores [attachments] but no AI/path code (PathNode 0x199F7F/0x19A0FE/0x19A2CD, setmode 0x183B9D, A* 0x2B29F0) is reachable from road code within two calls. [Roads] path nodes built in 0xD605C are not traced past parsing and may feed AI navigation.

facts.title: Trigger re-arm and random reset
facts.fact: Re-arm is in MATrigger base sub_0014524D, called first by Point update sub_00145A14. While TriggerEnabled (+0x89) is set it clears Has-fired (+0x88) when: UseRndReset (+0x9D) set and clock (double 0x4E2440) > due (float +0xA8); or ResetIfHaveInvalidCheck (+0xAC) set and +0xAD==0; or TriggerAutoReset (+0x9C) set. Fire sub_001452D4 sets +0x88=1, ++count +0x98, and if UseRndReset due=clock+RNG(RndResetTimeMin +0xA0, Max +0xA4) via sub_0001DBE0 on [0x524A74]+4 (0x145463-0x145486). Seconds and uniform distribution inferred. Correction: leads 0x1443CF/0x144474/0x1446D0/0x1447A3 belong to MAModSubObjectSplash/MASubObjRespondTranslate. Radius update switch reads dword [ebx+0xE4] (recomp_0032.c:20768), not +0xC4 (a byte gate in sub_00145A14); re-check which is TypeOfCheck (supersedes the +0xC4 claim in trigger-check-vehicle-type-gate).

facts.title: MissionVariable and AllowClientActivate use sites
facts.fact: MissionVariable (+0x90): at fire sub_001452D4 (0x1453B4) indexes byte table 0x4EB9E0; sub_00145D77 (MATriggerRadius slot 11) and sub_00148BB7 (MATriggerTimer slot 7) also read it. AllowClientActivate (+0x8A) read at 0x145382; with bit 17 of [ebx+0x1C] (0x145378) it picks between two fire paths. Meanings (mission-variable flag table; client fire path) inferred.

facts.title: Unit type bits by class for trigger tests
facts.fact: sub_00199586 (recomp_0042.c:10901): MAMech (0x4EAF78): 0x01 Avatar if bit17 of [unit+0x26C]; else 0x10 BattleArmor if bit18 of [unit+0x268]; else 0x20 Mech. MATank (0x4EAF84): 0x04 Turret if sub_00109FE2(unit)!=0 (reads [unit+0x8C]); else 0x02 Tank. MAFlyer (0x4EAF98): 0x08 VTOL if bit2 of [unit+0x260]; else 0. Other classes 0. Pilots on foot and Battle Armor are MAMech subtypes; turrets are MATank subtypes (labels inferred from Test* key names). Helper sub_0019955F.

facts.title: The game RNG is MT19937
facts.fact: MT19937 (N=624, M=397, A=0x9908B0DF, standard tempering), old-style seeding: mt[0]=seed (seed 0 -> 0x1105), mt[i]=69069*mt[i-1] mod 2^32. Twist runs lazily one word per draw (same stream). Index at state +0x9C0. XBE checks: mag01 0x4540EC={0,0x9908B0DF}, imul 0x10DCD, cmp 0x270, 0x1105. Float draw r=u32*2.3283064e-10 (1/2^32, XBE double 0x4540F8). rand(a,b)=sub_0001DBE0=a+r*(b-a) on x87. Seed sub_0001DA00, twist/temper sub_0001DA60. Same RNG drives culture placement (state gen+0x1D4) and trigger random reset (object [0x524A74]+4).
facts.how_to_use: Reproduce culture placement bit-exactly once gen+0x2C is known.

facts.title: Culture cell order and instance build
facts.fact: 0x50F4EC=2*pi (set by 0x321390 from XBE 0x493C94), 0x50F4F0=360/2pi (0x321370), static initialisers. Cell order: seed RNG; draw r for count; per attempt if unsnapped draw jitter x then z, each rand(0.001,0.999); slope and nearest-neighbour tests; if accepted draw yaw=rand(0,2pi) only when RandomRotation, then always scale=1+rand(-R,R); a rejected attempt used only its jitter draws. Instance build sub_0018063B: y=terrain height (sub_000F70A9); up=terrain normal (sub_000F70FC) if AlignWithSlope else (0,1,0); sub_0024F430 converts (up,yaw) to Euler degrees via vtable +0x24/+0x2C/+0x34 on (inst+0x8C)+0x40; uniform scale to inst+0x94 vtable +0x38; model from factory sub_00161D77(gen+0x78) or a reused pooled instance. Which Euler angle is yaw inferred. Refines culture-seed-and-placement-order (jitter is x then z). Open: writer of gen+0x2C (likely the UID, inferred), whether NN test sub_00180518 draws from the RNG.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: try the generator UID as gen+0x2C.

facts.title: Sky dome fog height formula and fog colour fallback
facts.fact: Game fogs the sky dome per vertex: q = clamp((SkyFogTop-h)/(SkyFogTop-SkyFogBottom)), h = 10000*(model_y + SkyTerrainSkyOffset.y/SkyTerrainSkyScale.y). Ill Wind: Top 1500, Bottom 500, scale (460,470,460), offset (0,-140,0); trace fit q=4.47-10*model_y. Equivalent reading h=21.28*(scale.y*y+offset.y) is indistinguishable on this map; a second map's sky trace is needed to separate them. Fog colour: this sky has no SkyFogOn/SkyFogColor, and trace fog colour FF583524 equals the world MAEnvironment FogColor (0xFF243558), so the sky falls back to the world FogColor (byte order differs: trace is BGR-swapped). Editor result on Ill Wind mountains: before (48,58,84), after (38,54,87), game (37,52,84). Refines sky-fog-q-explained (the -2970 origin is Offset.y/Scale.y*10000 = -2979).
facts.how_to_use: Use the offset-aware height formula in the editor sky VS.

facts.title: Trace 'textures %05X' word = NV097 SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM, 5 bits per stage
facts.fact: The textures word in nv2a_gpu_d3d11.c (key.words[2]) is the NV097 SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM register (method 0x1E70), 5 bits per stage. 00C01 = stage0 2D(1), stage1 off(0), stage2 CUBE(3); 00C21 = same with stage1 2D(1). So bit 0x20 is NOT a specular gate: it is whether stage 1 (detail/mask texture) is on; the cube sits in stage 2 in both. Static program sets are D3DPIXELSHADERDEF (0xF0 bytes, PSTextureModes at +0xD8): family 0x4A5480 has texmodes 0x401 (no detail) / 0x421 (detail); 0x4A5C00 family (via inst+0x4C when [inst+0x20]&7==4) has 0x8001/0x8021; 0x4A5840 family in inst+0x50 unused-as-found. Tables hold no cube mode; the draw-time D3D code (function 0x40FBD0, writes method 0x41E70 at 0x40FF3E) remaps each stage mode by bound texture: test dl,4 at 0x40FDEC turns modes 1.3 into 3 (CUBE) when the texture format word has bit 2; else 2 (3D) for flag 0x40000000 or (fmt&0xF0)==0x30, else 1 (2D). jns tests at 0x40FE45/0x40FEBD zero a stage mode unless 4,5,0xA,0x11 (per-stage no-texture gate, field unconfirmed). Shadow PSTextureModes at device+0x790 (0x40C16C, set at 0x40C0A0). Lamp vs mech difference is per material/per draw: non-empty mat+0x98 detail_blend string (0x421 family) or a texture actually bound at stage 1; not object class, dynamic light or vertex format. The material parser 0x4CFE0 reads cubetexture into material+0x74 (0x4D228-0x4D26C) but sub_00073340 / setup 0x736B0 never bind it. Unknown: who binds the stage-2 cube (global or per draw); why the mech has a stage-1 binding with only a basetexture (parser 0x4D172-0x4D18D appears to fail on an empty detail_blend list).
facts.how_to_use: Do not gate the specular stage on word bit 0x20 as a material property; treat the cube as always present in stage 2 for these programs and stage 1 as the mask/detail.

facts.title: MATriggerRadius TypeOfCheck is a dword enum at +0xE4
facts.fact: TypeOfCheck is a dword at runtime +0xE4 (slice 0xC4): save sub_00146055 pushes [ebx+0xC4] (recomp_0032.c:20166), load sub_00146434 stores [ebx+0xC4] (20613) on the slice pointer, update sub_001467B1 switches on [ebx+0xE4] (20768). Same +0x20 rule for CheckVehicleType (store +0xD6, read +0xF6). The +0xC4 byte gate in sub_00145A14 (19387) is AttachToPlayer (slice 0xA4), inherited from MATriggerPoint. It is an enum 1.4, not a bool (dictionary conv wrong).
facts.how_to_use: Supersedes the +0xC4 claim in trigger-check-vehicle-type-gate.

facts.title: MATriggerRadius update cases by TypeOfCheck
facts.fact: sub_001467B1: 1 = loc_00146986: object at [ebx+0xC], nation test vs global 0x4E4E84, lookup sub_000B4F70, gated by CheckVehicleType. 2 = loc_00146862: RadiusSet (+0xDC) lookup, compares [+0x28] with global 0x4E4E88. 3 = loc_0014682A: exits if NationCompare (+0xE0)==-1, else PlayerEntitesOnly (+0xF5) picks sub_00146C8E (0) or sub_00146AED (!=0). 4 = like 3 but only when +0xF8 != 0. Other -> loc_00146A5F, which switches on CombineMethod (+0xEC). Runtime offsets (slice+0x20): RadiusSet +0xDC, NationCompare +0xE0, CombineMethod +0xEC, PlayerEntitesOnly +0xF5, CheckVehicleType +0xF6. Dispatch code-confirmed; meanings of 1, 2, 4 inferred (3 = player in area). Open: bodies of sub_00146AED/00146C8E/000B4F70; who sets +0xF8.

facts.title: MissionVariable flag table 0x4EB9E0
facts.fact: 0x4EB9E0 is a 30-entry byte table of MissionVariable flags. Trigger reader sub_001452D4 (18223-18234) indexes it by MEM32(ebx+0x90), reading only 1<=index<30. Writers: sub_001A94A1 (MAActionMissionVariableSet slot 22, stores [obj+0x68]), sub_000F235C (MARoot objective restore), sub_0016990A. Readers: sub_00148BB7 (MATriggerTimer slot 7), sub_000F175D (MARoot save), sub_00169A49. Size 30 documented in bringup oracles; writer semantics inferred. Open: index 0 is skipped by the reader though oracles write it; sub_00145D77 was said to read it but has no literal 0x4EB9E0. UPDATE 2026-10-24: see mission-variable-table-confirmed (sub_00169A49 is a reader; sub_00145D77 does not read the table; gate semantics).
facts.how_to_use: Mission variable indices 1.29 are usable.

facts.title: Z2W LUT binding
facts.fact: Apart from create (sub_000541B0) and teardown (sub_00054670) only sub_00055150 touches the Z2W pointers; it binds Z2WLookup0 (0x50C72C) and PrecisionLookup (0x50C734) via texture vtable +0x6C with stage args 1 and 2 (0x55380-0x553F6). Water draw sub_000547F0 calls it at 0x5486D in pass-mode 0. The sampling pixel program was not found. Stage numbers inferred.

facts.title: Z2W texel is view distance/192; t15 thickness form preferred
facts.fact: Texel clamp(-P1/(192*(P0-t)),0,1) is view distance/192 saturating at 192 m, not thickness. Constants: 0x493CC4=1/192, 0x493CC8=65280, 0x493C34=1/65535, 0x493AF4=-1. t15 form a=sat(8*(sceneDepth-waterDepth)+V0.a^2) is consistent (8/192 per metre; 5.67 m sample gives 0.236 vs observed T1.a 0.244); t12 form sat(vertical/4) has no vertical term on this path. LUT code-confirmed; t15 form inferred (combiner not decoded). Resolves the conflict noted in water-z2w-lut: lean t15. UPDATE 2026-10-24: confirmed by the frame-trace decode (water-thickness-rc-program).
facts.how_to_use: Editor: depth is along the view ray, 1/192 per metre.

facts.title: Z2W LUT parameters P0/P1
facts.fact: P0=G+0x23E0=M[10]+S and P1=G+0x23F0=M[14], M the row-major 4x4 at G+0x2374 (written at 0x44721), G=[0x524AD0]. S = -1e-7 * argument of renderer slot 87 (sub_00037690), negligible. Projection _33/_43 terms; for a standard D3D projection near=-P1/P0. (0x3AE40-0x3AE80, 0x37716-0x37720). That G+0x2374 is the projection matrix is inferred.

facts.title: Water pass index byte 0x50C720
facts.fact: Byte 0x50C720 is a water pass index 0-5: reset to 0 by sub_00038F20 (renderer slot 70), incremented by sub_00056CB0. Switch in sub_000547F0 (table 0x548D0): 0 = LUT bind (sub_00055150) + sub_00056480 + sub_00054CF0; 2 = sub_00056480 + sub_00054CF0; 4 = sub_00054CF0; 1, 3, 5 go to the tail. Switch runs only when dl==1 or mode==5 (0x54833-0x54838). Pass names inferred. Open: pass-0 pixel program and stage-0 texture; PrecisionLookup fill path; meaning of dl, V0.a, waterDepth; in-game trace of P0/P1 and stages 1-2 at pass 0.

facts.title: Nothing switches a plain MACorporeal lamp's bulb at run time
facts.fact: IsNightTime (g_env+0x1C4) is read only by MABuilding slot 11 (sub_00127ED7) and env copy sub_001265CB. +0x80 bits tested by MACorporeal code are its own flags. Entity loader sub_000B3540 defaults VisibleEntity (+0x38) to 1 (0xB36D3) and reads CreationTime into +0x34 flags (0xB36A1); neither it nor mtb attach sub_000D743B calls the node show/hide setter sub_00082020. So a lamp keeps its load-time .mtb state, always on or always off by data; which for Env_Highway_Light is undecided. Contradicts the t12 fact that bulbs are lit at night: treat that fact as unverified.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: do not tie lamp bulbs to the night toggle; show .mtb default state; only MABuilding LIGHTS groups follow IsNightTime.

facts.title: MAModSubObjectShow Execute
facts.fact: Execute sub_0013ED10 (vtable 0x471C20 slot +0x60): target via slot +0x78 (sub_00107B2B), show flag from +0x100 and state checks, then sub_0013EF51 -> sub_00082020 on the target node (call 0x13EDA0). +0x101 selects subtree mode; +0x100 and +0x102 together gate a second update (sub_000820F0). Does not look up nodes by name. None of 137 functions making indirect [reg+0x60] calls is owned by MACorporeal/MAEntity/MAMover/MAEffect, so a ModSubObjectShow placed on a lamp probably never runs (inferred). Callers of sub_00082020: MAModSubObjectShow (0x13E9DA, 0x13EF51), MABuilding sub_00127ED7, MACorporeal slot 11 sub_000D7B3D, slot 113 sub_000D75C7 (reads VisibleEntity). Open: lightbulb node visibility bits in Env_Highway_Light.mtb; which field the renderer tests (+0x38 or +0x34 bit 2); sub_000D7B3D indirect [eax+0x1C4] call.

facts.title: AIRange (env+0x1A0) is live but is one packed colour channel
facts.fact: sub_00126440 is called only from MAEnvironment apply sub_001234D6 (vtable 0x46DA38 slot +0x2C) with esi=env (0x12356D/0x12356F). It reads env+0x1A0 (0x12645F), scales by 255, converts four channels with sub_0030A5C0 and packs via sub_00081310 into [X+0x20]+0x1C, X=[0x50C958]+0x18. So the field named AIRange is live but as a colour channel, not a range; the name is probably a wrong label. Consumer of renderer +0x1C untraced. Corrects menv-airange-no-consumer. NOTE 2026-10-24: the apply reads entity+0x1C0 = reader+0x1A0, so the CoolingWaterway AI-feed attribution may be wrong (menv-reader-on-plus-0x20).

facts.title: FogMode values: 0 none, 1 linear, 2 linear + height band
facts.fact: FogMode (env+0xF8) -> sub_00126A2A -> sub_00081350 -> fog vtable 0x45C8A0 +0x124 (sub_000373D0, stores mode at [0x524AD0]+0x2438) -> sub_0003AEB0. Mode 0 writes state 0x5C=0 (fog off); 1 writes 0x5D=3 (linear) plus start/end; 2 writes 0x5D=3, 0x5E=0, 0x5F=1.0 and sub_0003B0A0 computes a height-band ramp. EXP/EXP2 never written. Fog state at [0x524AD0]: +0x2438 mode, +0x243C colour, +0x2440/+0x2444 range, +0x2448/+0x244C band. 0x5C=enable and 3=D3DFOG_LINEAR inferred. Answers t15 FogMode 2 (exponential?): linear plus band.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: FogMode 2 = linear fog + height band.

facts.title: Sun colour and direction fields
facts.fact: Sun colour env+0x88 (4 floats); apply calls sub_001268D3, which packs it and sends it to the light object at env+0x354 (0x1235A8-0x1235B0). Sun direction most likely env+0x98 (3 floats): apply passes &env+0x98 to the light object's vtable +0x34 (0x123594-0x1235A5) (direction offset inferred). Serializer default DirectionalLightDirection (1,-1,1) (0x124D8E-0x124DC8). Open: table vs vertex fog flush, sub_0030A5C0 clamp/wrap, renderer +0x1C consumer, light-object +0x34 target (factory key 0x4BB3EC), global [0x50E454] in a tan term in sub_00126440.
facts.how_to_use: Sun direction default (1,-1,1), normalised.

facts.title: Road [Roads] path-node append wrapper
facts.fact: 0x000D605C is a 38-byte wrapper (temp ctor 0xD5073, leaf 0xD628F, temp dtor 0xD5037) writing [Roads] path-node record `index` (0x58 bytes each) into a caller-supplied vector, growing it when index>=count (recomp_0022.c:4993; call site 0xD5CCA, index [ebp+0x68], base [ebp+0x78]); writes no global. Node types PATHNODE_CENTERLINE/SIDEWALK/ROAD (0xD5E97), EXIT/ENTRANCE (0xD5EDD), with connect/nConnects. No AI path code reachable within two calls, so AI use is unproven; base origin unknown.

facts.title: MACorporeal/MASky2 shared slot-11 method and parent class test
facts.fact: 0x000D7B3D is the shared slot-11 method of MACorporeal (vtable 0x466BA0) and MASky2 (0x46EA70); MARoad has its own (0xD52A3). It reads the parent's class id ([this+4]+0x28) and returns 1 at once (0xD7F2E) if parent is MASpawner (0x4EB050, cmp 0xD7BC7) or MACollectionArea (0x4EB054, 0xD7BD3). A MAPlayer parent (0x4EAED0, 0xD7C1F) takes a separate branch. If [this+0x84] bit 0x10 is set (0xD7C88) it calls 0xE0161 (0xD7C93), whose only caller this is; 0xE0161 as the .road loader and the meaning of bit 0x10 are inferred.

facts.title: Roads: ground lightmap pre-pass then EQUAL material pass
facts.fact: Cross-reference: shadow receivers (all 966 retail MARoads have ShadowReceiverType 1) get an untextured ground-lightmap pre-pass then an EQUAL material pass (model-ground-lightmap-prepass, ground-prepass-is-shadow-receiver). This answers the EQUAL-vs-LEQUAL open item in road-no-runtime-conform. No z-bias found in the MARoad call graph (direct calls only).

facts.title: PC DrawDistance scale = 2^((DD-50)/50)
facts.fact: PC setting Display/DrawDistance (default 50, range 0-100): scale=2^((DD-50)/50), DD100=2x, DD0=0.5x (kit/source/game/src/pc_draw_distance.c). Four runtime readers: LOD (34), lightmap extent (56), camera far (82), fog (99). Ortho cameras exempt. CONFLICT: fog-drawdistance-fit (fog ~1.1724-0.000575*DD) does not match the exponential; code wins unless the fit measured something else.

facts.title: How draw distance reaches camera, fog and LOD
facts.fact: Camera builder sub_00044BE0 writes scaled far to camera+0x80 on entry and restores authored far at epilogue loc_00044D21 (recomp_0007.c:12128-12131; bringup/patch_draw_distance.py). Authored far = MAFreeCamera far clip (read 0x0011DC5E; default 475 m). Scaled far feeds projection and the CPU six-plane node cull (sub_00257740); terrain patches have no separate DD clamp. MAEnvironment fog start (232, read 0x00130334) and end (240, 0x00130379) are scaled before the environment render call (recomp_0028.c:29440); fog colour is not. NodeSwitchLod (sub_000848E0, recomp_0014.c:8638) divides squared distance by scale^2.

facts.title: Ground lightmap window size from far plane, not DD directly
facts.fact: Window origin from camera frustum, size from far, near and projection. sub_00052F90 (recomp_0008.c:27437-27481; caller recomp_0005.c:22522): E=max(E_xbox, D), D=max(2*far*sqrt(s), sqrt((far-n)^2+(far+n)^2*s)), s=1/px^2+1/py^2, n=camera+0x7C, px/py=camera+0x194/+0x1A8, far DD-scaled (pc_draw_distance.c:64-78). Ortho (camera+0x88), camera+0x1C0!=1 or bad input returns E_xbox. No DD50 bypass, so the PC window can differ from stock even at DD50. In-game DD100 window ~2083 m at 4.07 m/px is already verified-in-game in the wiki. Open: esp+0x128/0x12C, texel snapping and 512 px mapping after recomp_0008.c:27494, constants 0x50E0DC, 0x493A5C, sub_00044A90.

facts.title: MACinema slot +0x1C is shot advance, not skip
facts.fact: Slot +0x1C (sub_001559A0) returns unless cinema+0x78 is set, calls the current controller's slot +0x1C(0) (0x1559E2) and steps the shot index only when that controller's +0x94 byte is 0. Past the last shot it calls Stop (sub_00155B53), clearing 0x4EB198/0x4EB19C (0x155BC9-0x155BCF). No button read, no jump-to-end. Nothing calls it directly. 0x4EB198 is read only in sub_000171E0 (0x173CD), which calls Stop(cinema,0,0) while active. Skip-button path still unfound.

facts.title: Byte 0x50C85C gates cinema side effects
facts.fact: 0x50C85C is 0 in the XBE image and has no absolute-address writer among its 121 references, so it is 0 at run time unless written via pointer. Readers gate cinema side effects: Start (sub_00155A99) sets game singleton byte game+0x42=1 (0x155B04) only when it is 0 (cmp 0x155AE4) and calls 0x18F30/0x16B2F1 only when 0 (0x155B26); controller start sub_001565B5 (0x156624) takes a branch calling sub_0011DE33 when 0. 'Debug flag that suppresses side effects' inferred.

facts.title: game+0x42 byte flag
facts.fact: game+0x42 (singleton via sub_00161B4B / 0x50C958) is a byte flag. Cinema Start sets 1 (0x155B04); advance clears it (0x155A32) when cinema+0x9C and the next controller's +0xE2 are both set; sub_00017B20 clears it at five sites and reads it (0x17B90, 0x17C46); sub_00016880 writes it (0x168FA). Input lock during cinematics unproven. bSkipTo (key 0B477508) belongs to MAFreeCameraController (Skip to this shot, 0 in all 350 retail uses); no reader found. Open: generic dispatcher of slot +0x1C and whether any path passes 1; whether sub_00017B20/00016880 gate input.

facts.title: Catalog's inferred MATerrainInfo properties are culture/impassable descriptors
facts.fact: The 26 inferred MATerrainInfo properties (of 74) are culture-bitfield descriptors (cultureBF0-4 Name/Shift/NBits/Mask/Color0, culturenBitfields, cultureWidth/Height, cultureBitmap) and ImpassableBF overlay colours. None affects rendering; no runtime read site (CRC keys appear as no immediate; no function strings contain cultureBF/ImpassableBF). The culture map is read through MACultureType+0x84. Look like tool-side metadata (negative scan).

facts.title: MATerrainInfo movement category table
facts.fact: Slot 11 (0x000F736A, 313 bytes, recomp_0024.c) zeroes 11 dwords at this+0x88 and stores handles for Impassable - All, Impassable - Ground Movers, Impassable - Non-Mech Ground Movers, Shallow Water, Deep Water, Waterway, Lava, Deep Lava, Impassable - Player: a movement/AI category table. facts.title: MATerrainInfo loader: TextureName%d and step effects
facts.fact: Loader 0x000F75BA reads nTextures (key B484B54E) via vtable +0xC (0xF75DA), then per i formats TextureName%d (push 0x46997C at 0xF761B) and appends an object to the list at this+0x58 (0xF767C). Also loads Default step effect (ParticleEffectDefault, key 9C511177, 0xF773C) and ParticleEffect%d per terrain type (format 0xF76B6) into a container at this+0x94. facts.title: Specular mask texture = the material's detailtexture
facts.fact: SPECULAR_MASK parser sub_0004DB80 reads the material's detailtexture entry (push 0x45E534, default 0x45E541 = empty string, at 0x4DBF5-0x4DBFA) and loads it into mat+0x6C via texture loader sub_00069D70 (basetexture -> mat+0x68) (recomp_0008.c:5199, 5235-5239, 5295-5304). So the 64x64 DXT1 mask on stage 1 is whatever file detailtexture names; no fixed name. The string at 0x45E541 clue is a dead end (empty default). The PC .mat parser maps detail to detailtexture (models/src/model.cpp:439). Actual Mission_16 filename unverified. Resolves the unknown in specular-mask-second-texture and part of ps-texture-program-word.
facts.how_to_use: Editor: load the material's detailtexture as the mask; base.a stand-in is wrong in principle.

facts.title: Texture loader caches by name per context
facts.fact: sub_00069D70 -> sub_002612E0 -> sub_00261CE0 searches a 32-byte record table at context+0x2C by name (compare sub_00309D80) and reuses a hit (recomp_0011.c:1203-1250; recomp_0064.c:29513, 32228). One loading context loads one texture per name; materials share a mask only if they name the same file. Other material parsers (sub_0004C080, COMPLEX sub_0004CFE0) push the same empty default. Empty-name skip and table lifetime inferred. The verified-in-game combine out=2*V0*base+mask.r*cube.a*spec_color stands. Open: owner and lifetime of context+0x2C; where the environment cube binds on this path.

facts.title: MASpawner 'no limit' becomes 10 total spawns
facts.fact: In MASpawner slot 11 (0x001325B5), cmp [edi+0x7C],0 at 0x1326E3 and cmp [edi+0x90],0 at 0x1326EB clue to mov [edi+0x7C],0xA at 0x1326F4: when both MaxSpawners (+0x7C) and MaxActiveSpawners (+0x90) are 0, MaxSpawners becomes 10. Loader writes MaxSpawners at 0x132728 (fn 0x13270D). Answers the open in maspawner-spawn-rules (init writes MaxSpawners=10).
facts.how_to_use: Editor: MaxSpawners 0 + MaxActiveSpawners 0 means 10 spawns, not unlimited.

facts.title: MASpawner counters
facts.fact: Spawn 0x0013321F (slot 7) increments NumSpawned (+0x98) and NumActive (+0x9C) together (0x133305, 0x13330B). Each spawn is gated by its own non-zero max (MaxSpawners vs NumSpawned, MaxActiveSpawners vs NumActive; 0x133251-0x13326B); a zero max means no cap. The [ebp+8] flag can skip both increments (0x133303). Bit 0x01 of +0x78 is the Enabled gate (0x13322E). Dictionary types NumActive as bool; it is a counter. NOTE: offsets differ from maspawner-spawn-rules (+0x78/+0x7C there); this batch's runtime offsets are the checked ones.

facts.title: Only decrement of NumActive is the walker 0x1BE20
facts.fact: The only decrement of +0x9C in the XBE is walker 0x0001BE20 (0x1BEA1); twin 0x0001BD50 increments (0x1BDC1). Both climb the +0xD4 parent link checking the mike tag and change only the top entity. Spawn creator 0x00133648 never writes the unit's +0xD4 and callback 0x00133C3A only appends unit IDs to list +0xC0, so no spawner-level death callback was found: a unit's death may not lower its spawner's NumActive unless the spawner is the chain root. Recount 0x00157CD0 (from 0x157C4F when byte +0x82 set) zeroes +0x84.+0xA0 and re-adds from children; class unconfirmed. How NumActive drops in practice is unknown (needs an in-game check). DISPUTED 2026-10-24: see spawner-numactive-disputed. MaxActiveSpawners likely a lifetime cap (inferred).

facts.title: MASpawner one-at-a-time spawn handshake (bit 0x10)
facts.fact: Bit 0x10 of byte +0x78 is set at 0x133C99 (fn 0x00133C70, unit ID +0xA4, handle +0xB4, state +0xB8) and cleared at 0x133DA6 (fn 0x00133CB7, called at 0x13323F) when the state-2 handle matches. Gate at 0x133244 blocks new spawns while set. Name inferred. Open: bits 0x02 and 0x08 of +0x78 (0x133372, 0x1331B9), CountJackedAsKilled.

facts.title: MAEnvState setters run once from slot 11
facts.fact: The six rate setters are called only from sub_0012F774 (slot-11 override), only if base sub_000C364B succeeds and [[this+4]+0x28]==[0x4EAFEC] (recomp_0030.c:8274-8333). Update sub_001308FC calls slot 11 (vtable +0x2C) once in its pending branch after the deadline gate (indirect call 0x130957, recomp_0030.c:11034), then clears pending +0x81. Ctor sets +0x80,+0x81=1 and calls no setter. Each channel then moves linearly at |target-current|/fade. Closes the open in envstate-setters-and-guard.

facts.title: SkyFogChangeDuration 0 freezes the transition
facts.fact: sub_00130E72 returns 0 when SkyFogChangeDuration (+0x10C) is 0. sub_00130E06 has no zero-rate branch: returns 1 only when the value already equals the target, else moves by dt*rate (clamped) and returns 0. Update clears active +0x80 (loc_001309B7) only when all six appliers return nonzero; the fog applier needs all seven sub_00130E06 calls to return 1. So with duration 0 any off-target channel freezes and the MAEnvState never finishes; channels already on target finish at once. It does not snap. A finished MAEnvState deactivates itself; generic writer sub_0012E9ED can set +0x80/+0x81 on any object but its wrappers sub_0012E9C1/9C9 have no direct callers (re-arm not ruled out). Only the fog applier was fully read. Open: slot 16 sub_00130EB0 callers elsewhere, rate-field initial values when link check fails, base ctor sub_000C3545. Refines envstate-rates-and-guard.
facts.how_to_use: Editor preview: SkyFogChangeDuration=0 means frozen, not instant.

facts.title: HUD RadarDist is read by retail code
facts.fact: Player radar range is HUD property RadarDist. sub_002057F5 (recomp_0053.c) loads it (name 0x484214 at 0x205853), default = object's current +0x18C, stores the result back at +0x18C (fstp 0x205870). +0x18C is also read at 0x205839 and in Radar slot-5 handler (0x205AA9, read 0x205AE0; use not decoded). The wiki's RadarDist not read holds only for the PC port. Retail value unknown (not in catalog; log the store at 0x205870 in game). CORRECTION 2026-10-24: retail reads RadarDist (radar blip drawing 0x204133); 'unread' is PC-port only (radar-range-retail-vs-pc).

facts.title: PC bots radar range 300 m
facts.fact: PC bots use radar_range = env RECOMP_BOT_RADAR, default 300 m (kit/source/game/bringup/staging/bots/core/ma2_bots_core.c, TODO: RadarDist HUD +0x18C); brain compares distance against it (staging/bots/brain/ma2_bot_brain.c:534). 200 m fallback only when radar_range <= 1. For comparison MAMover EngageView (Attack view range, +0x210) defaults to 80 m; bots-ai-tuning-props lists EngageRadius 400 m, EngageRadiusPilot 50 m. Catalog puts +0x210 under MAProjectile so its owner is open. Staging tree value; shipped bots tree unchecked.

facts.title: bots-defense-decision-table vs the code
facts.fact: Against kit/source/game/src/bots/ma2_bot_defense.c and ma2_bot_ctrl.c: wpn_value_vs (line 426) has no caller (weapon choice by defence not wired); seekers vs jammers value x0.6 (432), not avoid; Reflective/Reactive value=1-absorbed fraction (136-146), not zero; missiles vs AMS only AMS-flagged projectiles and only while AMS is up (148); 0.4 cutoff appears as ctrl:319 stopped>=0.6; extra rules: range gate (429), cloak-strict=0 (433), active shield=full stop (149). Matches: shield arming when BattleArmor within 30 m (brain:1118, MA2B_SHIELD_RANGE). Not found: raising defence for energy groups or AMS-bound missiles; def_own_ready (437) has no callers. Whether that tree ships in the PC build is unknown.
