facts.title: sub_131D6C is a free function: one-shot pickup latch and notify
facts.fact: Bit 0x02 of pickup+0x1A8 is a one-shot latch: if set the call is skipped, otherwise it is set before the notify. Notify = pickup->vt[+0x124] = 0xDF911 (MAPowerUp vt 0x470200 slot 73, shared with MACorporeal), ecx = pickup, arg1 = [pickup+0x1AC], then three zeros; +0x1AC is a forwarded payload, never written or compared here (meaning inferred). Bit 0x01 gates sub_DF216(collector): returns if [collector+0xA4] == 0, else calls sub_12AF3B 8 times; nothing here sets 0x01. Callers of 0x131D6C: 0x10063D (checks 0x02 first), 0x109217, 0x115E74, 0x115EF3, 0x129606, 0x1E0200. Open: writer of +0x1A8 bit 0x01; sub_12AF3B on collector+0xA4; DF911 arg1 use; +0x1AC property name (not in MAPowerUp slice); global 0x4EB210. CLARIFIED 2026-10-24: bit 0x01 SET -> calls DF216 (powerup-pickup-chain-writers). RESOLVED 2026-10-24: DF216 refills weapon groups (powerup-pickup-is-weapon-refill).

facts.title: 0x16C067 is the predicate of a synchronous tree search, not a callback registration
facts.fact: RESOLVES the 'callback registration?' open of mech-zone-code-builder: 0x16C067 is the predicate argument of sub_B2B70, a synchronous recursive subtree search (first child at node+0xC, sibling at +8; aborts when the predicate returns 0; the arg4 gate is 0 at all sites; ~40 callers = general node-tree search). The match returns through global [0x4EBA88]. Predicate: if entity+0x28 != [0x4EB01C] continue; if entity+0xBD equals the value selected by the code, store entity and stop. Code 0/1 -> BD 0, code 2 -> BD 1 (code-confirmed), code 3 -> BD 2 (documented). Enclosing functions: sub_16C374 (code = its stack arg; referenced from 0x16C2F6) and sub_1DE650 (codes 2 and 3; only a data reference at 0x322EE0, not a known vtable). +0xBD byte writers (classes unattributed): recomp_0029.c:17252, 17665-17714 (constants 0-3, possibly a table), 17795; recomp_0031.c:7805, 8450; recomp_0032.c:9002, 11706, 11788; recomp_0033.c:3336, 3713, 4273, 4382. facts.title: MAMech flag word 0x268 bit 17: every immediate write is a clear
facts.fact: MAMech 64-bit flags at 0x268, bit 17 = byte 0x26A mask 0x02. Every immediate write found is a CLEAR: 0xFF5A5 (sub_FF3FB, beside 'or 8' = SET bit 19 at 0xFF5AC) and 0x1021F3 (sub_102102, beside the bit-19 clear at 0x1021E6). No immediate set of 0x02 at 0x26A and no dword immediate 0x20000 on 0x268. sub_FE263 / sub_FEB88 do NOT touch bit 17 (queue premise wrong): FE263 sets bit 46 (+0x26D 0x40) and clears bit 12 (+0x269 0x10); FEB88 clears bit 46. Bit 17 moves with bit 19 (clamped/attached, wiki t01a:2105); sub_102102 (~18 callers) is the BattleArmor release path, so bit 17 is probably part of the clamp state (inferred). Not 0x26C bit 17 (IsPersonMech, 64-bit bit 49). Open: the setter is a register store; candidates: edi store at 0xFF51C, dword [esi+0x268],ebx at FEED9 (0xFF08D/0xFF0A5), xor [edi+0x268],esi at 0x105EF2, full stores 0xFC623/0xFC70E. Register-copy readers: and ecx,0x20000 at 0xD393E/0xE4952; and eax,0x20000 at 0xEDD58. Runtime watchpoint on entity+0x268 during a BA clamp/release. facts.fact: SUPERSEDES corporeal-184-flag-pair (flag inference wrong). MACorporeal +0x184 = CURRENT HEALTH (int); +0x180 = MAX HEALTH (name inferred). facts.fact: Vtable 0x467A64 = MAMover secondary table at obj+0x20 (slots [0xE706E, 0xE826B, 0]). EVERY subclass ctor calls 0xE6A0E, then overwrites [+0], +0x20, +0x24, +0x78: MAMech 0xF7E69 (primary 0x469CD0, +0x20 0x469CC4, +0x24 0x469CBC, +0x78 0x469CB4); MATank 0x10861B (0x46AE48 / 0x46AE3C); MATurret 0x10C0AF (0x46B130 / 0x46B128); MAVehicle 0x10D531 (0x46B448 / 0x46B440); MAPerson 0x10F06F (0x46B760 / 0x46B758); MAFlyer 0x110B55 (0x46BC38 / 0x46BC2C); MASpider 0x116BC3 (0x46C118 / 0x46C110); MAUberBoss 0x157E8C (0x4758B8 / 0x4758B0); MAMiniSpider 0x17C11A (0x477CF8 / 0x477CEC); MAProjectile 0xEC0C1 (+0x20 0x4680B0, slots [0xEC597, 0xED2EF, 0xD8221]). Each +0x20 table sits 8 or 0xC below the primary; slot 1 = class property loader (MAMech 0xFAA65). every subclass loader chains to the MAMover base loader 0xE826B (call sites: MAProjectile 0xEDF55, MAMech 0xFC4C2, 0x1091B3, 0x10CBBA, 0x10DE04, 0x10F7A8, 0x1126EA, 0x1189DD, 0x1593F4, 0x17CD9F). Index fixes: MAMover ctor = 0xE6A0E (not 0xD702D); add the per-class +0x20/+0x24/+0x78 tables and 0x4680B0 as vtable starts.

facts.title: Additive sky layers fog toward black with coefficients (2, -0.5)
facts.fact: Additive sky layers (sun, moon, clouds) fog toward BLACK (fog colour 00000000) with coefficients (2, -0.5): keep = saturate(1.5 - 0.5 q), q = (Top - h)/(Top - Bottom). Opaque and alpha-blend sky layers use (2, -1) with the real fog colour. Seen in BD, IW and UC additive sky draws. Confidence high. facts.title: Bit 17 of +0x268 has no code setter; copy-state xor sites
facts.fact: Full-dword stores 0xFC623 / 0xFC70E write back the value just loaded from [esi+0x268] (only a byte op on +0x26E in between: bit 3 of byte 0x26E = +0x26C bit 19, cleared at 0xFC61A, set at 0xFC707): not setters. No or/mov of 0x20000 (and no or of 0x02 into byte +0x26A) targets entity+0x268 in direct code; only clears (and byte [+0x26A],0xFD at 0xFF5A5, 0x1021F3). MAMech copy-state 0x105EF2 xor-diff copies from source ebx into dest edi: entity+0x268 bits 18 (0x40000 BattleArmor, 0x105F3D), 24 (0x1000000 SlowToFire, 0x1063BB), 25 (0x2000000 EvasionShot, 0x106402), 26 (0x4000000 EvasionRun, 0x10641F), and +0x26C bit 17 (IsPersonMech); all other [edi+0x268] xors use esi = 0 (no-ops); no 0x20000 mask on +0x268. VERDICT (inferred): entity+0x268 bit 17 has no code setter, only set by property load (if a loader bit maps there) or never; treat as clear-only. The loader tests bit 17 of [esi+0x1C] at 0xFC600/0xFC62E (different word; only or-0x20000 into a +0x1C dword is 0x1E23E2, base unknown).

facts.title: Weapon def +0x160 capacity, +0x164 current; refill skipped when def+0x78 bit 0x100 set
facts.fact: Weapon def +0x160 = capacity (max), +0x164 = current: sub_D6CC8 (edx=def, ecx=value) stores def+0x164 = min(def+0x160, max(ecx,0)) (0xD6CCE-0xD6CD9); refill caller sub_12AF3B passes ecx = def+0x160 (0x12AF69) -> refill to full ('ammo' naming inferred). sub_CC4A9 = has-ammo predicate: (def+0x160 == 0) (def+0x164 > 0); capacity 0 = unlimited (inferred). sub_12AB32 sets def+0x78 bit 0x100 from its byte arg (mov ch,[esp+4]; xor/and 0x100/xor) and when arg != 0 zeroes def+0x164 (0x12AB4B): bit 0x100 = forced-empty / no-ammo state. facts.title: Zone damage primitive 0x1A9E5E and the TakeDamage chain
facts.fact: Zone damage primitive sub_001A9E5E (ecx = zone record, eax = damage): if byte [rec+0x10] != 0 -> no damage, return 0 (zone locked/invulnerable flag); else rec+4 -= damage, clamp >= 0, rec+8 = cur*100/max, return 1. Zone record extends to +0x10 (byte flag) within stride 0x14. Chain: MAMech TakeDamage sub_00100A52 (vt+0x1D0, slot 116; block = [mech+0x260]) -> sub_0016C2E0 (adds flag 1) -> sub_0016C139 -> sub_0016C2F6 (code != 0 -> code lookup sub_0016C374 must succeed) -> sub_0016C336 (zone index 0.5 bounds check, skip if cur already 0) -> sub_001A9E5E. Closes the open 'nothing subtracts zone HP' item: the chain never writes +0x184 and bypasses accessors 0x16C416/43F/472. After the zone call TakeDamage reads [esi+0x268]/[esi+0x26C] (bit 17/19 pair); torso-death writer 0x100BE8 is a separate function right after TakeDamage (0x100A52+406). Open: 0x16C139 damage/code derivation; TakeDamage tail 0x100B7C-0x100BE7.

facts.title: 0x16C0CF = arm limb-destroyed handler; empties arm weapon; zones 4/5 never chosen
facts.fact: sub_0016C0CF (106 B, called from 0x16C336 when zone cur reaches 0) = ARM limb-destroyed handler: acts only for zone record index 4 or 5, owner (*block) alive (owner+0x94 != 0) and child P3 non-null; node = P3 vcall +0x78; 0xE04E1(node, owner+0xB78, 'Left Arm') (name search, inferred); then 0x12BCB5 on owner+0xA4 which calls 0x12AB32 = weapon-def forced-empty setter (sets def+0x78 bit 0x100, zeroes ammo) -> destroying an arm empties/disables that arm's weapon. BUT in the TakeDamage chain the branch looks UNREACHABLE: 0x16C139 calls 0x16C2F6 only with zone 0 (0x16C20D) or zone edi when edi is 2 or 3 (cmp edi,1 at 0x16C212; edi = rand&3 via sub_1DA60). Zone choice is NOT hit-location based: zone 0 always, plus a random second zone 2/3 if sub_16C374's child search (predicate 0x16C067, +0xBD = zone-1) succeeds. Damage not scaled in 0x16C139; value = TakeDamage [ebp-8]: 0x30A5C0 (float source+0xB0) -> vcall +0x1C8 out-ptr (0x100AFF) -> replaced by vcall +0x1CC return (0x100B3C) -> passed at 0x100B73 with eax = [mech+0x260]. TakeDamage arg3 (init -1) = player/slot index validated by 0xC8DAE (inferred). Other caller of 0x16C139: 0x0C46CF (in 0x0C45E6, unanalysed; may reach zones 4/5). facts.title: Sky fog q is height-based; dome scale K=10000; c7 = dome origin
facts.fact: Sky fog is HEIGHT-based: q = (y - SkyFogTop)/(SkyFogBottom - SkyFogTop), y = world height; uploaded vec4 (1/(B-T), -T/(B-T), 0, 1) by sub_0003B210 mode 3 from G+0x2498 (written by sub_00037500 = renderer vt 0x45C8A0 slot +0x144, renderer state not per-draw). sub_0012AA21 (per camera update; callers sub_0011CFA5/sub_0011DD64) calls SetSkyFogBand(Top, Bottom), scales the sky model by K = float [0x493B9C] = 10000.0 (vt+0x38) and sets model position V = P + SkyTerrainSkyOffset*(K/SkyTerrainSkyScale.y) (vt+0x30); P = camera position via sub_00161B4B->+0x2C->vt+0xE0->vt+0x24 (inferred). MASky2 offsets: Offset +0x1AC, Scale.y +0x1BC, Top +0x1C4, Bottom +0x1C8, model ptr +0x94. Editor-observed c4.c6 = 10000*identity = the dome scale K; c7 = (373.3,166.0,1762.5) = dome origin V (camera + offset*K/scale.y), NOT raw camera (mapping inferred; upload site not found). Fog vec4 register is runtime: writer 0x40BF20 (ecx = [[0x524ABC]+0x68]+0x60) appends {0x41EA4, reg, 0x100B80, payload} to push buffer [0x4197C0]. Open: sky caller among sub_0003B210's 6 callers; runtime [[0x524ABC]+0x68]. UPDATE 2026-10-24: UC per-mesh y scale/offset. facts.title: B5350/B4EF0: child-first deferred-delete teardown by uid
facts.fact: sub_000B5350(hit) walks the hit+0xC child chain (next at +8) via walker sub_000B2BE0 with callback sub_000B4EF0, then if the walk returns nonzero calls sub_000B4EF0(hit, 0). sub_000B4EF0 = per-object teardown: owner = obj+0x60 -> owner vt+8 (unlink, 0xB4F06); obj vt+0x34 (0xB4F0D); if obj+4 != 0: 0xB6700, 0xB66A0; owner bookkeeping 0xB4DF0/0xB4FC0/0xB5830; obj vt+0x54 (0xB4F56); obj vt+4(obj,1) = deleting destructor (0xB4F62). B4F70 matches the uid lookup: ecx = world, esi = uid; queue at world+0xA4/+0xA8; entity+0x2C = instance uid. So the queue = deferred-delete by uid, child-first tree teardown. This is the path of the open freed-node crash (sub_15D741 -> B5D60 -> B5350 -> B4EF0 -> B6700). Free itself inferred. Resolves the 'B5350 body' open of deferred-release-key-queue. facts.title: Ground (light/shadow) map T3 window: inputs, clamps, static block 0x534CAC
facts.fact: Ground (light/shadow) map T3 = per-frame 512x512 target over a camera-placed window ~2 km square (~4 m/texel; see ground-lightmap-is-camera-window / uc-terrain-light-ground-map-t3). Origin from the real camera frustum; size from far plane x tan(hFOV/2), bounded by frustum diameter, then level clamp, then texel snap. PC hooks ma2_pc_lightmap_parameters (far plane via Draw Distance, hFOV widened to the rendered projection) and ma2_pc_lightmap_extent (frustum diameter) only change inputs; retail update logic kept (pc_draw_distance.c:49-78). Retail window function = recomp_0008.c:27400-27545: camera vt+0x24/+0x30 reads, extent compared with stack limits esp+0x128/+0x12C (level bounds, inferred), result in static block 0x534CAC.0x534CB4 with init flag byte 0x534CB8 bit 0. Draw Distance therefore changes ground-map coverage. Camera offsets: +0x7C near, +0x88 skip flag, +0x194/+0x1A8 projection x/y, +0x1C0 == 1.0. Answers part of editor ask T3.a / backlog B5. facts.title: UC sky fog q mismatch = per-mesh y scale/offset
facts.fact: sub_0012AA21 sets ONE transform for the whole sky model each frame: uniform scale K=10000 on x/y/z (same 0x493B9C float, vt+0x38) and position V = P + Offset*(K/Scale.y) (vt+0x30); Scale.x/z never read; Scale.y only as the K/Scale.y divisor ([esi+0x1BC], 0x12AA4F-0x12AAA0, 0x12AACD-0x12AAFF). So each mesh carries its own y scale (~0.83/~1.01) and offset (~-0.1 model units): per-node local matrix composed into c4.c7, or per-mesh position scale/bias in vertex data (inferred). Editor draw_sky (render.cpp:668-703) applies only the sky-wide transform and no per-mesh node local transform -> likely the mismatch. Upload site of c4.c7 not found statically (sub_000511C0 0x51290-0x51379 uploads only material/program consts via 0x40BF70/0x40BF20 and fog vec4 via 0x3B210). Settle at runtime: same-frame dump of c4.c7 for both draws: c5.y~8315/10100 and c7.y~-818/-853 => node matrix baked into c4.c7 (editor must multiply each mesh's node local matrix); c5.y=10000 and c7.y=166 => factor is in vertex data. Also check whether the editor GpuModel loader already bakes node locals into vertices; MASky2+0x94 looks like a scene node (world matrix node+0xC0.0xFC) (inferred). Supersedes the dome-origin reading of c7 in sky-fog-height-q-and-dome-scale (V.y = 166 is the dome origin; per-mesh factors are separate). facts.title: Converters 0x33C10 / 0x33AF0 are variant getters (tag 6 u32 / tag 3 i32), not bool

facts.title: sub_E6999 returns the Absorber defence (DefenseType 6); 0x1872A0 absorption arithmetic
facts.fact: sub_000E6999(EAX=mover) returns [mover+0x220] only if it is an ABSORBER (vt slot +0xC returns DefenseType 6 via 0x186931 `push 6; pop eax; ret`; absorber vt 0x478B90, base 0x478D98) else NULL: TakeDamage's 'E6999 non-null' = mover has Absorber defence (Reflective/Reactive/EAS armor), not shield(1)/jamming(4)/camo(5)/AMS(7). Absorb 0xE9A10 -> 0x1872A0(ECX=absorber, EAX=dmg, type, splash) returns pass-through damage: unchanged unless +0x94 absorbing set, hit-kind byte (splash -> +0x38, direct -> +0x39) set, DamageAbsorbed = float[+0x48+4*type] > 0 and dmg > 0. absorbed = trunc(dmg*DamageAbsorbed[type]); pass = dmg - absorbed. If +0x24 <= 0: return pass (no drain). If HP +0x8C <= 0: absorber off (0x18768A), return dmg. Else HP -= trunc(absorbed * float[+0x5C+4*type]); +0x90 = max(+0x90, float[+0x70+4*type]); overflow when HP<0 and byte[+0x84+type]: pass += max(0, absorbed - trunc(HP_before/cost)); HP=0, off. Absorber vt slot +4 (0x186A44) loads AbsorbsDirectDamage / AbsorbsSplashDamage / PercentHeatNotAbsorbed (names for +0x39/+0x38 and a per-type table, inferred). sub_000E9A31 = HP/+0x24 (or 1.0) -> +0x24 = absorber max HP (inferred). Wiki 'Absorb calls 1872A0 only while up' is loose: gating is inside 0x1872A0. Open: type index source and which index = energy; 0x1874C9. facts.title: UC sky fog q verified by per-vertex VS dump: per-mesh matrix = K x MGMODEL node world matrix

facts.title: Message ctor 0x175EB5, send helper 0x175EF1 and copy-ctor mechanics
facts.fact: 0x175EB5 is a message CTOR (vptr 0x466D9C, [+8] = 0x66, [+0x1C] = 0, flag bytes +0x18/+0x19, list init +0x20 via 0x2B03E0), returns this; never touches edx. Send helper 0x175EF1 (thiscall; slot 2 of vt 0x466D9C = virtual 'clone self and post') zeroes edx (0x175F08) so caller edx is dead; it allocates 0xBC bytes from pool 'Moe\MoeMsg' (0x175F2E, global 0x50C864) into ebx, runs ctor 0x175EB5, then COPY CTOR 0x1005E3 (0x100612 copies +4.+0x14 incl. +8 at 0x100623/0x100626; then bytes +0x18/+0x19, dword +0x1C, rep movsd 0x27 dwords +0x20.+0xBB) from the template message in ecx, then pushes ebx onto FIFO 0x4B9978 via 0xB8C20. So the queued msg+8 = template+8, with 0x66 only as the fresh-ctor default. Message layout: +8 code, +0xC/+0x10 ctor args (sender/target), +0x14 type id 0x44AB0817, +0x18/+0x19 flags, +0x1C dword, +0x20.+0xBB payload. Slot 0 0xDD645 dtor-like, slot 1 0x175EE6 IsA. The per-send input is ecx = owner/template at most sites (0xDBBCA esi+0x24, 0xDC3C8 ebx+0x24, 0xDD174 ebx+0x24, 0x1A04D8 edi+0x24, 0xE1B6A (MACorporeal/MAEffect slot 88 -> 0xDD174), 0xF7E69 edx 0); of 41 call sites 26 -> 0x175EF1 directly, 4 -> 0xDD174. Only two immediate stores set a code: 0x175EDB [ebx+8] = 0x66 and 0x179D86 [ebx+8] = 0x65 (ctor sub_179D36, vt 0x477CAC); copy paths 0x100626 (clone) and 0xDD683 (copy ctor sub_DD669 from sub_DD610) copy +8 from the source. In 3 of 29 sampled callers (0xC9F15/0xC9F1C, 0xCA671/0xCA680, 0xDBD14/0xDBD1B) the template in ecx is a STACK message freshly built by 0x175EB5 (sent code 0x66); DC3C8 likewise builds via 0x175EB5 (0xDC599) and sends via 0x175EF1 (0xDC5AB): 0x65 , 0x66 out. MACorporeal ctor 0xD702D stores the dispatch interface vt 0x466B90 at [entity+0x24] (0xD706D), not a message vtable. Null-alloc path writes through ebx=0. Open: what sets template +8; upstream of the X+0x24 owners. Ignore the 'DISPUTED' template-location wording above.

facts.title: MAMech heat: +0x85C HeatCurrent, SetHeat 0x10528D, cooling tick 0x1052FF, delay timer +0x860
facts.fact: mech+0x85C = HeatCurrent (f32); TakeDamage absorber path adds damage * absorber+0x34 INTO HEAT (absorbed damage becomes heat). 0x10528D = SetHeat(float) (stdcall ret 4, this in EAX): +0x85C = min(v, 1.2 (0x458278) * [+0x854]); +0x864 = int(heat / [+0x854] * 100) (0 if base 0; 100.0 at 0x493B48); then 0xE9E21(percent) -> tail-jmp 0x182F3C when predicate 0xE69D0(this) (likely overheat notify, undecoded). Cooling tick 0x1052FF (only caller MAMech slot 7, VA 0xFC4F2): while timer [+0x860] > 0, timer -= dt (double 0x4E2428, runtime-set) and no cooling; else heat -= [+0x858] (cool rate) * dt -> SetHeat. +0x854 = effective heat capacity (100% base) - set by ctor 0xF827D and loader 0xF8793 (store 0xF8B9B, then mulss gated by cinema flag 0x50C85C / class 0x4EAED0); catalog HeatMax +0x850 has no reader found. Heat readers: slot 74 (+0x128) 0x105522 heat ratio; slot 16 (+0x40) 0x105EF2 copies heat/+0x854 to another mech; SetHeat callers 0x14AC23, 0xC45E6, 0xD1EBD, 0xD3EE3, 0xEDF7A. The only arm of the cooling-delay timer +0x860 is 0xEDF64 -> 0xEDF7A ('weapon fired' handler): if [mech+0x28] == [0x4EAF78] (MAMech classid, writer recomp_0081.c:1449 from desc 0x4AF5E0, desc+0x24 -> 0x46A744 'MAMech'; entity+0x28 holds a classid, so this is a CLASS test, applying to bots too, not a local-player gate), SetHeat(heat + [edi+0x364]) and timer = max(timer, [edi+0x360]) (store 0xEE088); edi = the event source (probably weapon/barrel: +0x364 heat per shot, +0x360 cooldown; inferred). Other +0x860 writers: ctor 0xF7E69 zeroes (0xF829D); tick 0x1052FF decrement/clamp 0 (0x10533B); 0x2A7AB0 zero/restore; generic store 0x2A545A (fn 0x2A52E0; renderer range - aliasing, inferred); 0x198173 is MAEffectChain. 0x182F3C (22 bytes) only stores arg to [this+0x4C] if [this+0x3C] non-null and its first dword 0; entry 0x182F52 sets byte [this+0x48] = 1; the overheat effect lives in readers of +0x48/+0x4C. facts.title: Zone record semantics and the arm-destroyed spawn chain (0x16C0CF -> 0xE04E1 -> 0x161D77)
facts.fact: 0x1A9E5E (34 bytes, no calls; ecx = R+4): if gate byte [ecx+0x10] != 0 return 0 unchanged; else CUR -= X, clamp CUR >= 0 (no cap at MAX), PCT = CUR*100/MAX, return 1. NO difficulty floor on the damage path; sub_000F61B0 returns a [0,1] fraction (K = 1.0 at 0x493A60) used by the MAMech slot-11 pass that raises CUR via 0x16C416. Zone record R = block + 0x14*zone (block = mech+0x260, zones 0-5): +4 MAX (0x16C3F7, no clamp, no zero guard), +8 CUR (destroy test is CUR == 0 exactly), +0xC PCT (no reader found); negative X (heal) uncapped; 0x16C336 skips when CUR already 0, calls arm handler 0x16C0CF when a hit leaves CUR at 0 and ignores the return. Chain 0x16C139 -> 0x16C2F6 -> 0x16C374 (find node + target) -> sub_0016C336(eax = block; stack X = damage, target, node): target never read. sub_0016C0CF (arm destroyed; zones 4/5 only, needs block[0]+0x94 != 0): 0xB41E0 on [node+4] (sets bit 0x200, tail-jmp enqueue 0xB5DF0); sub_000E04E1(target re-derived via node->vt+0x78, block[0]+0xB78, 'Left Arm' - one literal for both zones); sub_0012BCB5 on block[0]+0xA4 if non-null; nothing touches node+0xB8. sub_000E04E1 = create-and-link (0x161D77 on part owner key +0x60; two B2B70 searches with visitors 0xE05AC (0xB5930(child+0x60,1)) / 0xE05BF; then target+4 ->vt[1](ebx+0x94)). 0x161D77 (ret 0x1C) = spawn-from-template: eax = template uid; finds template T in registry K+0x24 (K = ecx owner key, via B4F70); new node from factory B50D0 keyed by T's classid; sets node+0x30 = uid, node+0x28 = classid if unset; registers in K+0x30 under P7 or K->vslot4 key; binds via B5930(K,0); returns node (0 on failure); optional P4/P5/P6: 0x161D5F, 0x161F49(node,P1), B2B70(node,0,0xB4080,0) + 0x1620AD (activate subtree); same path as the bot-spawn fact (0x166C0C -> 0x161D77 -> B2B70(.0xB4080)). B5930(K, flag) (ret 8) = rebind: re-resolves child+0x30 in K+0x24, checks classid matches T, calls child->vt[+0x40](T, flag); on failure sets child+0x1C |= 0x40000000; adds T to K+0x88 if K+0x84 set and [0x50C85C] == 0; not a hide/delete itself. Owner key K = child+0x60: +0x24 template registry, +0x30 instance map, +0x84/+0x88 deferred list. => arm destruction spawns a new object from a template (detached arm / debris; 'detached' inferred). Index cdecl labels on 0x161D77/B5930 wrong (callee-clean). Open: vt+0x40 (T,1) effect on the arm class; B50D0 factory / B5F70 map insert; gate byte writer; PCT readers.

facts.title: New River City terrain: no ground light map; two-pass detail+micro combine measured in game; editor rule fixed
facts.fact: Pass 1 (detail combine): out = 8 x C0.a(0.298) x V0 x T0 x lerp(T2,T1;T0.a) via stages s0.s4 (s0 R1=T1; s1 R0 = T0.a*R1+(1-T0.a)*T2; s2 x C0.a x2; s3 x T0.rgb x2; s4 V0 x R1 x2; final = FOG.a*(V1+R0)+(1-FOG.a)*FOG). V0 = per-vertex diffuse (ambient + sun x N.L; NRC V0=(0.149,0.149,0.196,0.5), V1=0 since the sun is at -11 deg). Pass 2 (micro) = dst x 2 x M, M = lerp(0.5 x (M0+M1), 0.5, T2); per-vertex fade T2 samples .033/.051/.080/.094 at eye depth w 7.9/9.3/12.2/13.9 m = (0.0497+0.0189 w)^2 (same fit as UC); pass2/pass1 per pixel 1.45/1.42/1.30 vs 2xM0 = 1.46/1.40/1.30. Colormap: T0 fetch = file texel (0.161,0.172,0.094, a 0.0); alpha 0 selects T2 = TerrainDetailMap 1, a=1 selects T1 = TerrainDetailMap (UC probe: file (.114,102,094,a .859) vs game (.116,104,097,a .84)). Fog (NRC) coefficients 4 / -0.003333: f = 3 - 0.003333 d (1 at 600 m, 0 at 900 m) = 2 x file FogStart/End 300/450 (DrawDistance x2). The editor used a wrong rule for no-light-map levels (ground ~0.65x too dark): fixed in editor commit 03e8f09 (branch fidelity). Open residual: game pass-1 BLUE ~1.25x the formula (+1.4/255) while R,G match (same sign as UC B 13% low; final-combiner constant?). Horizon scatter (low green bushes) is absent in the editor on Deliverance/KF. Old s19 game shots predate the render-target swizzle fix: do not use them for lit-ground brightness; fresh game-vs-editor pairs (KF, NML, OverFalls, IYF, NRC, Deliverance, OnTheRocks, ProvingGround, UC) agree on ground 1.0-1.2x in R,G and sky. Frame-trace camera: VS c58 (unit, w 0) = forward, c59 (w 1) = player FEET; editor camera = c59 - 6.25 x fwd, +2.1 m up, vertical fov 50.789 in the editor viewport.

facts.title: ecx at 0x175EF1 is a stack template from ctor 0x175EB5, never entity+0x24; message endpoints at msg+0x0C/+0x10
facts.fact: (1) ecx at 0x175EF1 is always a STACK template built by ctor 0x175EB5 (lea ebx,[ebp-X]; X = 0xBC/0x58/0x48/0x44; mov ecx,ebx): 11 of 29 callers sampled (0xDC596/0xDC5AB, 0xDD6E0/0xDD6ED, 0x103800/0x10380D, 0x11F466/0x11F470, 0x13237E/0x132399, 0x154662/0x15466F, 0x1A050A/0x1A0520, 0x1AAF21/0x1AAF37 plus msgcode2c's three); 18 callers unsampled. Never entity+0x24. (2) 0x175EF1 = post-copy: alloc 0xBC via 0x175F2E (heap tag 'Moe\MoeMsg'), construct blank via 0x175EB5(ecx=edx=0), copy template via 0x1005E3 (+0x18/+0x19 bytes, +0x1C dword, 0x27 dwords from +0x20), post the copy to global queue 0x4B9978 via 0xB8C20; returns al=1; the caller's stack message may die after the call. (3) entity+0x24 (dispatch interface, vt 0x466B90) is passed only as ecx/edx of ctor 0x175EB5; base ctor 0xB6770 stores ecx -> msg+0x0C, edx -> msg+0x10 (message endpoints; usually two different entities' +0x24, same entity at 0x1AAF1C/1F). Which is sender vs target is inferred only. (4) Ctor 0x175EB5: vt 0x466D9C, +8 = 0x66, +0x14 = 0x44AB0817 (type tag; predicate 0x175EE6 compares it), +0x18 = 1, +0x19 = 0, +0x1C = 0, +0x20 payload init 0x2B03E0. Open: msg+0x0C vs +0x10 = sender/target (drain of queue 0x4B9978 / 0xB8C20); the 0x9C-byte payload at +0x20 (0x2B03E0). facts.fact: (1) dword 0xEDF64 occurs once in the XBE, at 0x4680A8 = slot 0 of its OWN 2-slot vtable 0x4680A8 {0xEDF64, 0xB2870}. facts.title: TakeDamage 'source' is a damage RECORD: it READS REC+0xC0 (type) and REC+0xC4 (amount); wiki direction was backwards

So the wiki's 'writes source+0xC0 out' had the direction backwards: it READS REC+0xC0 (damage type) and writes the caller's local. Chain: 0x12CF58 (vt 0x46F0FC slot 0, installed at [obj+0x24] by 0x12CC61 and 0x12CCF8 = MABuildingDestroyed's +0x24 iface) -> 0xDC2E5 (0x12CF61) and 0xDC3C8 (0x12CF70); 0xDC3C8 reads REC from its arg (0xDC3D5), target = [REC+0xC]-0x24, TakeDamage on target at 0xDC3F9. With ref-175ef1, REC is a message (msg+0x0C endpoint): damage arrives as a 0x65-type message whose +0xC0/+0xC4 carry type/amount (inferred). Projectile DamageType (CRC EF98B75B, string 0x468430; loader 0xEC597 pushes [ebx+0x350] into 0x33830 at 0xECE75/0xECE81 = read/serialize, object offset +0x370 with +0x20 bias, inferred; dictionary code_hits 'write' at 0xECE86 is actually the key load). facts.title: Vector 0x52AB98 = per-frame list of 20-byte light-like records, drawn through renderer vt+0x104 (slot 65) at 0xAD399
facts.fact: Sole writer sub_000ACFE0 (game_vtable, no recorded owner): one-time init (guard byte 0x52ABA4 bit 0; atexit dtor 0x326BB0) then clears the vector each call (end = begin, capacity kept). Append helper sub_000AD5D0 copies a 20-byte record to *end (0xAD1F6-0xAD204). Per element E (P = E+0x150 ->vt+0xC): 0x00-0x08 vec3 from E+0xF0 (position); 0x0C float P+0x0C + t*X; 0x10/0x11 bytes = lerp(P+0x14,P+0x18,t) / lerp(P+0x15,P+0x19,t); 0x12 byte int(N*t+E'); 0x13 byte int((1-t)*96.0) (0x493EB8 = 96.0); no texture handle - looks like dynamic point lights / fading light particles with radius at +0x0C (inferred). Consumer 0xAD186 (second entry into ACFE0's body, skips the clear) calls renderer slot 65 (vt+0x104 = sub_00038E60, thiscall, 8 args) at 0xAD399 with P8 = 0, P7 = count ((end-begin)/20), P6 = begin, P5-P3 = caller locals, P2/P1 = caller locals; the list is rebuilt and drawn in the same call. Other +0x104 sites (0x176865 in fn 0x176791, 0x372D0B in fn 0x372CA5) are not the renderer. 0xAD186/0xACFE0 have no static callers (runtime pointer); a runtime trace (log return address at 0xAD399) is needed for the frame position. facts.title: Message queue 0x4B9978 drain: delivers to msg+0x10 (target); msg+0x0C is the sender/source endpoint
facts.fact: Pop loop 0xB8C60 (calls 0xB8D10 per message until read==write), entered from 0xB45F0 (vt 0x4641D4 slot 6) and 0x15D741 (vt 0x45396C / 0x475F1C slot 9). With ref-175ef1/ref-edf64 the target +0x10 is e.g. the projectile's +0x24 iface and handler 0xEDF7A uses [msg+0xC]-0x24 = the OTHER endpoint (shooter): +0x0C = sender/source (handler-confirmed, not drain-confirmed). Correction to message-queue-4b9978-drain: the drain does NOT test cookie +0x14 itself (maybe validator 0x175EE6, unchecked). Message ctor 0x179D36 itself stores code 0x65 (recomp_0039.c:18546): all 31 call sites (27 fns) build 0x65 messages: sub_000F06C3 (MAProjectile#79), sub_000E2F8E (shared slot 97), sub_000E2EBE (slot 96, ecx=0), sub_000EEB49, sub_000DB541, sub_001E7F80, clone sub_00179DC5; ctor does not store msg+0x0C (callers pass ecx/edx as +0x24 interfaces, e.g. E2F8E: ecx=ebx+0x24, edx=eax+0x24; msg+0x0C write site not located; candidates 0x1005E3 / 0x100612). facts.fact: 0xE6C55 = MAMover base of vt slot 11 (+0x2C, init hook), called by slot-11 overrides of MAProjectile, MAMech, MATank, MATurret, MAVehicle, MAPerson, MAFlyer, MASpider, MAUberBoss, MAMiniSpider. +0x1E8 bit 0 = AIEnabled: cleared at 0xE6C8E only for MAPlayer-parented movers ([[this+4]+0x28] == [0x4EAED0]) (the bot patch round10 replaces this clear); copied via 0x185BF6 to X+0x90. The difficulty multiply is NOT gated by bit 0: it runs after 0xD7B3D + predicate 0xE6E8E, if [this+0x60] != 0, byte 0x50C85C == 0 and descriptor [sub_18F10+0x69] == 0 (NOT a network session); it scales +0x214 / +0x218 in place (mulss 0xE6D18 / 0xE6D31) and loads +0x1EC BaseAccuracy; non-idempotent => once per object at init (inferred). Bots relevance: if the offline Bots mode sets descriptor +0x69 (see net-flag-69), difficulty scaling of AI weapons is SKIPPED. The five 'bit 0 writers' listed earlier are NOT mover code (the +0x1E8 offset collides across classes): 0x1F0DFA (fn 0x1F0D60, NAL peer-record setup, Src\Nal\Peer.cpp, caller CNAL:Initialize 0x1EC3D0) and 0x1F124A (fn 0x1F1200, NAL connection-state reset) are network-library structs; 0x1F9E1D (fn 0x1F9A88, menu Activate handler; address taken in fn 0x1FA241, '~Auto Menu: Xbox Live Login' vt 0x482438 slot 5) is a UI object; 0x151955 (MACheckpoint ctor fn 0x15193D, vt 0x474A30; or [ebx+0x1E8],-1) and 0x1524BB (fn 0x152494 via MACheckpoint slot 13 0x151A3F: adds ebx to the checkpoint list vector 0x50E610 then ORs all flags) are a MACheckpoint field. Global vector 0x50E610 = MACheckpoint list (inferred). Mover-side setter candidate (unchecked): wiki 'Travel sets actor+0x1E8 |= 3' (t01b_bots_code.json:2689). facts.title: SetHeat feeds the CAMOUFLAGE component (type 5) heat percent; heat above 40 % degrades camo; overheat vetoes fire for heat-limited weapons (def+0x78 bit 0x1)
facts.fact: CORRECTS defence-component-actor-220-types-5-6 ('no heat code reaches 0x182F3C'; '+0x4C = duration?'): SetHeat sub_10528D (caps heat at 1.2 x (+0x854), const 0x458278, and sets +0x864 = int(heat/(+0x854)*100)) -> sub_E9E21 (call at 0x1052F5, only caller) -> jmp 0x182F3C for a type-5 (CAMOUFLAGE) defence: stores heat PERCENT at camo [+0x4C] (0x182F4C) only if gate [+0x3C] non-null and *gate == 0 (ctor 0x182346 stores one reg into +0x3C and +0x4C). Camo vt 0x478A50: [0] dtor 0x1823A3 nulls the gate; [3] push 5; [7] 0x1824B1 -> 0x1826E0 -> updater 0x1828D3 (gate-guarded) reading +0x4C via 0x18283A / 0x1827E2; [2] 0x182451 reads level +0x24. Mapping: pct <= 40 no heat term; 40-70: +0x28 = clamp((pct-40)/30, 0, 1) (0x182959); > 70: +0x24 = max(clamp((70-pct)/70, 0, 1), +0x24) (0x182946), +0x28 = 1.0; base helpers raise +0x24 to at most 0.65; active flag +0x48 never written by this chain => heat above 40 % progressively degrades camouflage (effect name inferred: visibility/shimmer). Open: what makes gate +0x3C non-null; reader of +0x28; in-game sweep heat 0-100 % with camo on. OVERHEAT VETO: gate sub_12BBEB: owner [arg+4] is MAMech ([+0x28]==[0x4EAF78]) and [owner+0x864] >= 100 (setge). sub_12B234 (cdecl, 7 params; 11 callers incl. fire sub_18482E) calls it once (0x12B240) and passes the byte via sub_12B2A5 -> sub_F13E9 -> sub_CFE30 arg [ebp+0x10], forwarded only to sub_D3178 (push 0xD01C6, call 0xD01CB). sub_D3178 (cdecl, ret 4) = CAN-FIRE predicate: returns 1 early if weapon+0x1E or entity+0x1E bit 0; returns 0 (veto) if overheated && weapon+0x78 bit 0x1 (cmp byte [esp+4] at 0xD31A0); 0 for null entity or weapon+0x78 bit 0x100 (no-refill/ammo gate, 0xD31A6); else 1 if capacity +0x160 == 0 or current +0x164 > 0 (0xD31AD). So overheat vetoes fire for weapons whose def+0x78 bit 0x1 is set (heat-limited weapons); no rate scaling. In CFE30 the veto is routed by state dword [ebp+0x14] (0-3) and flag [ebp-1]: some states exit 0 at 0xD01AA (weapon+0x79 bit 0x20 clear), others reach success 0xD0236; weapon +0x78 bits: 0x1 overheat gate (also required at CFE30 entry 0xCFF3B), 0x100 ammo gate, 0x200 set for state 0 (0xD01EF) and requires heat >= 100 (0xCFF83), 0x200/0x20 cleared for states 2/3 (0xD0201). [weapon+0x16C] = per-weapon MIN heat threshold compared with entity = sub_B4F70(world [weapon+0x60], uid [weapon+0x7C]) +0x864 (jl skip, 0xCFF6F-0xCFF7B); the entity is most likely the FIRING mech (inferred). Open: weapon+0x16C name; [ebp+0x14] state meaning; other CFE30 callers sub_F1458 / sub_CF637; +0x864 readers 0xD2035 / 0x138EA8. UPDATE 2026-10-24: the camo gate +0x3C starts NULL and is armed by vt[7] -> sub_1829FF (defense-type-remap-in-loader-e826b-and-camo-gate-arming). facts.title: Culture (tree) placer has no spawn/road exclusion; its NearestNeighbor spacing test queries a world-wide spatial index and counts any MACorporeal (not projectile/sky)
facts.fact: Driver sub_0017FD18 -> sub_00180950 + sub_001801F6 (x2); the only global reads are constants (1e-6 0x4541EC, 1.0 0x493A60, jitter 0.001/0.999 0x493AC4/C8, yaw max 0x50F4EC). No MALevelStart, road-list or footprint reads and no exclusion radius in the direct bodies (transitive 0x180986/0x18045F/0xF70FC/0x1805FE untraced). Distance tests are per-generator: NN spacing sub_00180518 (gen +0x98 NearestNeighbor vs 0.0 at 0x493A54); generation radius = StopFade (+0x94) + sub_001809CA term -> +0xB8 (sub_0017FB05); fade sub_0017FF5E scales Start/StopFade by the draw-distance multiplier; slope sub_001804C3 MinSlope <= acos(n.y) <= MaxSlope. REVISION (culturenn): the NN spacing test IS world-wide. sub_00180518 queries esi = [[0x50C958]+0x1C] (game singleton field; ctor 0x161510 zeroes it at 0x16152B) via vt+0x14 (pos, radius = gen+0x98, out-vector 0x52DB2C, 0) at 0x18059B. For each hit, class = [obj+0x128]; a hit counts when sub_000B3C50(class, MACorporeal 0x4EAF2C) is true AND class != MAProjectile (0x4EAF44) AND class != MASky2 (0x4EB00C) (accept/reject polarity at loc_001805E7 inferred = reject on hit). So any corporeal (buildings, mechs, props) within NearestNeighbor of a candidate suppresses the tree: a spacing rule, not a dedicated spawn/road exclusion; roads (if not corporeal) and MALevelStart do not count (unverified). Index probably SDS\LooseQuadTree (ctor sub_002B5990, vt 0x493808 slot 1 = 0x2B5AE0 insert candidate, slot 5 = 0x2B6040 query; stored to this+0x1C by creators sub_002B2190, sub_002B1780, sub_002B1C40, built at level load; 'this = game singleton' NOT verified; game object created in sub_001E0630, recomp_0050.c:178-249). Plaza bareness at Witch Cauldron is inferred to come from DATA (culture-map level 0 there; count = cellArea*Density*level): the editor should honour zero culture-map cells and thin trees around corporeal objects, not add spawn/road rules. Culture-generated entities get slot-11 init when placed (0x180749 in the stride-0x40 loop of 0x18063B 'Generated Entity', via MACultureGenerator slot 11 0x17F90C in 0x17F85C). Open: who fills [game+0x1C] and which classes are inserted (runtime write-watch on [0x50C958]+0x1C; trace 0x2B6040 hits by class); where the culture level is sampled; caller of sub_0017FD18 / window centre; default NN +0x98; runtime trace of sub_001801F6 (cell, level, NN result) at the WitchCauldron plaza. facts.title: World fog: MAEnvState FogStart/End x PC Draw Distance -> SetFogRange -> VS constants c[b+0x61.0x63]; game WC 5/-0.005 = editor 300/400 x 2
facts.fact: Chain: MAEnvState FogStart (+0xE8, read 0x130334) / FogEnd (+0xF0, read 0x130379) copied by sub_00130290 to edi+0x10C/+0x110, scaled by sub_00126A2A with ma2_pc_fog_distance (PC Draw Distance, 2^((DD-50)/50), kit/source/game/src/pc_draw_distance.c) and passed to renderer vt +0x134 = SetFogRange sub_00037450, which stores start -> G+0x2440, end -> G+0x2444 (G = [0x524AD0]) then calls 0x3AEB0 and 0x3B0A0; the +0x13C call (edi+0x114/+0x118) is probably the height band (sub_000374B0 sets G+0x2448/0x244C = P/Q). Constants in sub_0003B0A0 (recomp_0006.c:4981-5060): xmm3 = 1.0 (0x493A60), xmm4 = -1.0 (0x493AF4), xmm0 = 0.0, slope = 1/(E-S); with S start, E end, M = G+0x245C, t = (P-M)/(P-Q), V2 = clamp(t,0,1), V3 = max(t,0). The 12 slots G+0x2468.0x2494 go out as ONE vertex-shader constant upload (method 0x1EA4 index b+0x61, 12 dwords via 0x0B80; recomp_0006.c:5140-5148, sub_0040BF70), NOT NV2A fixed-function fog registers 0x9C0/0x9C4: c[b+0x61] = (-E/(E-S), -P/(P-Q), -V3*M/(P-Q), 0); c[b+0x62] = (-1/(E-S), 1/(P-Q), V3/(P-Q), 0); c[b+0x63] = (-1, 0, V2, 1); b = [[0x524ABC]+0x68]. Distance fog = (E-z)/(E-S) for eye depth z plus a height-band term. Gate: G+0x2438 == 2 -> upload path; == 1 -> sub_0004F930 and return (FogMode hypothesis). ANSWER: slope -0.005 => E-S = 200 m; the traced '5' fits either p0 = 1 + E/(E-S) = 5 or 1 - c.x for E = 800 => start 600 / end 800 = editor 300/400 x 2 (Draw Distance 100 doubles the range). The editor's authored values are right; the game applies the PC Draw Distance factor; mode linear; FogMode 2 = distance + FogBottom.FogTop height band (catalog enum, inferred), not exp. Open: P/Q/M identity (callers of sub_000374B0), modes 1 and 3, value of b, Draw Distance during the WitchCauldron trace, d units.

facts.title: MASky2 SkyFogTop/Bottom defaults 1500/500 (ctor); in-game coefficients (2,-1) need T=0.5, B=1.0 at runtime; SkyFogOn is a MAEnvState field
facts.fact: MASky2 create sub_0012A53C (alloc 0x1CC) -> ctor sub_0012A55B -> parent ctor 0xD702D (MACorporeal; the re-index record calling 0xD702D the MASky2 ctor is wrong). Ctor defaults SkyFogTop +0x1C4 = 1500.0, SkyFogBottom +0x1C8 = 500.0 (XBE 0x493E48 / 0x493BD8); stores this in global 0x4EB010 (live sky pointer, inferred). SkyFogOn is NOT a MASky2 field: it is MAEnvState offset 264 (read 0x130546, write 0x12FE5C); MAEnvState SkyFogStart / SkyFogEnd (+0x12C / +0x134) are distinct. SetSkyFogBand sub_00037500 (renderer vt +0x144) writes G+0x2498 = (1/(B-T), -T/(B-T), 0, 1) (stores 0x37537/0x3754A/0x3755A); with defaults (-0.001, 1.5, 0, 1): f = 1 at Bottom, 0 at Top. Sky update sub_0012AA21 (next to MASky2 vt+0x10 0x12AA1B) passes T = [sky+0x1C4], B = [sky+0x1C8] (call 0x12AAC7). sub_0003B210 mode switch on G+0x2438: 1 -> 0x4F930 only; 2 -> + two 0x40BF70 calls; 3 -> passes &G+0x2498 (the sky band) to 0x40BF20; other -> return 0x3B2B6: the sky band reaches the GPU only in mode 3. SetFogRange 0x37450 never writes G+0x2498; the other vt+0x144 caller (0xDC44B) pushes one dword (not SetSkyFogBand). The observed in-game (2,-1) is not a literal: it equals T = 0.5, B = 1.0 at runtime, so something overwrites the ctor defaults (or the level supplies normalised 0.5/1.0): for a Sky2 without SkyFogTop/Bottom/On properties (WitchCauldron) the game fogs the 3 sky layers with the world FogColor. Open: writers of MASky2 +0x1C4/+0x1C8 besides the ctor (candidates 0xE6A0E, 0xE49AF, 0xD2035); who sets G+0x2438 = 3 (sub_000373D0 0x373DB; byte stores 0x3B718); callers of sub_000374B5; which shader reads G+0x2498; whether SkyFogOn gates the 0x37500 call; runtime read of [0x4EB010]+0x1C4/+0x1C8 in WitchCauldron. UPDATE 2026-10-24: SkyFogOn is round-trip only; band stored at G+0x2450/0x2454; see sky-fog-band-consumer-and-skyfogon-unused.

facts.title: GoCommando/M02 road 7-stage pass is the ground-light pre-pass sampled as T3, gated by placement property ShadowReceiverType == 1 (not a reflection)
facts.fact: The 7-stage road pass is NOT a reflection. T3 = the 640x480 colour target holding the ground-lightmap PRE-PASS light: an untextured prog 0A624 pass with t3 = 512x512 ground map writes light into the frame; then the EQUAL material pass binds the frame as T3 with program bit 0x8000 (08C21/08021/08001). Stage 3 adds T3.rgb to vertex light, stage 5 uses T3.a*0.698 as specular, stage 6 multiplies the env cube T2 by it (verified-in-game from the M02 trace decode; consistent with wiki model-ground-lightmap-prepass / ground-prepass-is-shadow-receiver). Gate = placement property ShadowReceiverType (CRC 7A647510, 'Receives ground light') == 1; not a material flag, program id, MARoad-only rule or weather. Read in sub_000C3AB0: push name 0x464B6C at 0xC3CE8 (recomp_0020.c:12724), vt getter 0xC3CEF, store [esi+0x48] at 0xC3CF9 (catalog offset 0x68 on MAPlayerConfiguration = usual +0x20 bias, esi = object+0x20); a second identical read/store at recomp_0020.c:12437/12447. Retail data: roads 966/966 = 1, MAWater 66/66 = 1. Editor audit31 (pass A on ShadowReceiverType==1; MARoad always receiver) matches. Open: who branches on the field == 1 to emit the pre-pass; VA of the T3 frame-copy bind and of program bit 0x8000 selection (wiki candidate: light-pass class 0x45F8E0, sub_00060A60 / sub_00060B20; mesh dispatch sub_000547F0 on shading bits 3-5 + pass mode [0x50C720]). UPDATE 2026-10-24: the 'program bit 0x8000 selects the pre-pass' reading is not supported; see shadowreceivertype-catalog-owner-suspect-and-prepass-gate-open.

facts.title: Credit nibble comes from the loadout (class 0x4EB014) byte [+0x9C + weapon+0x80]; 0xD400B is a class compare, bit 23 = V >= 0
facts.fact: Helper called from sub_000D2035 at 0xD2ABF (arg1 = ebx actor, arg2 = [ebp-4]): walk arg1's children (0xD3FE5-0xD4013) -> weapon node (class 0x4EAF4C, last weapon-class node) + loadout (class 0x4EB014); V = int8 [loadout + 0x9C + weapon->+0x80] (0xD4024-0xD402A); +0x1E8 = merge((V<<14) & 0x3C000) (0xD4034-0xD403F); entry ORs 0x3C000 first so no match leaves 0xF (none). CORRECTION: 0xD400B is NOT a sign test - it is cmp esi,[0x4EB014] (loadout class compare). The sign test is test eax,eax 0xD404B / setge 0xD404D on V: +0x260 = (old & 0xFE7FFFFF) | ((V >= 0) << 23) (0xD4050-0xD405E). Bit 23 = 'credit valid' (inferred); bit 24 is cleared on entry and never set here. Early exits 0xD3FF2/0xD401E/0xD4022 skip the write. arg2 branch: if arg2 && sub_000B3C50(arg2), container = sub_000EB475(arg2) when class 0x4EAF98, +0x260 bit 2 (VTOL) set and [esi+4] class 0x4EAED0 (human player); else walk arg1; 0xD3F98 vt+0xA8 continuation undecoded. sub_000D406A also scans for class 0x4EB014 and reads loadout+0xAC (0xD40A5). V is only sign-tested (12.127 would give an out-of-range nibble with bit 23 set). Open: loadout +0x9C table contents (trace 0xD402A); readers of +0x260 bit 23; what sub_000D2035 passes as ebx / [ebp-4]. CORRECTION 2026-10-24: helper is sub_D3F29; writer chain via 0x12AE4D; bit 23 sign-vs-bit0 reading is disputed (kill-credit-nibble-writer-chain-lo9c-12ae4d).

facts.title: vt 0x4641D4 = MoeWorldDatabase; 0x475F1C derives from it (ctor 0x15CEE6); 0x45396C derives from that (ctor 0x12710); 0x124C0 is its deleting dtor

facts.title: So 5 / -0.005 = p0 = 1 + E/(E-S), p1 = -1/(E-S) -> E-S = 200, E/(E-S) = 4 -> start 600, end 800 = editor 300/4
facts.fact: So 5 / -0.005 = p0 = 1 + E/(E-S), p1 = -1/(E-S) -> E-S = 200, E/(E-S) = 4 -> start 600, end 800 = editor 300/400 x 2 (PC Draw Distance, kit/source/game/src/pc_draw_distance.c); the 'fogconst 5 = 1 - c.x' alternative is ruled out. Cross-check: BD fog 350-900 traced 2.636 / -0.001818 = 1 + 900/550, -1/550 exactly. Emitter: the ONLY fixed-function fog packet is XDK-D3D-side sub_00410150 (sole caller the PB dirty-state dispatcher sub_004110F0 when dirty bit 0x2000 of [0x41BC70] is set; lazy): header 0x000C09C0: [0x9C0] = P0, [0x9C4] = P1, [0x9C8] = 0 only when gate [0x41BDE8] (FOGENABLE) != 0; same block writes 0x0004029C (mode enum 0x2601/0x800/0x801) and 0x000802A0. Inputs are the D3D render-state cache: mode [0x41BDEC], start [0x41BDF0], end [0x41BDF4], density [0x41BDF8]; linear (mode 3): inv = K/(end-start), P0 = end*inv + K, P1 = -inv, K = 1.0 (0x493A60); EXP/EXP2: P0 = 1.5, P1 = density*K'; mode 0: 1.0/1.0. Cache writers 0x0040E340 (SetRenderState body; chains 0x427F0 > 0x40EE70 > 0x40EA60 > 0x40E340 and 0x415B70 > 0x415710 > 0x40F070 > 0x40E340) and default-init 0x004121D0 (table 0x418FAC). fogrs refinement: G DOES feed it via a queue: SetFogRange sub_00037450 (slot 77) stores G+0x2440/+0x2444, sub_0003AEB0 re-queues G+0x2438/0x243C/0x2440/0x2444 through 0x3BB80/0x3BA00; the renderer flush sub_00037BD0 (vt 0x45C8A0 slot 36) is the ONLY game-side caller of D3D wrapper sub_000427F0 -> 0x40EE70 -> 0x415B70 -> 0x40E340 -> dirty bit 0x2000 -> 0x410150 (flush this = G inferred). Range sources (2 of 26 `call [reg+0x134]` sites with float pairs): (a) sub_00126A2A (0x126AA4): start [edi+0x10C], end [edi+0x110] (MAEnvironment copy, Draw-Distance-scaled), from MAEnvironment slot 11 sub_001234D6 (0x123568) and slot 7 sub_00126060 (0x1260A5), also fog colour via slot 75 sub_00037400 -> G+0x243D/0x243E; (b) DEFAULT sub_0016165A (0x161739) SetFogRange(30.0, 200.0) (XBE 0x493B98 / 0x493BBC) from sub_0015D1E1 (0x15D1F4), plus pushes 0x1C (D3DRS_FOGENABLE, inferred) into sub_0001B8A0. Fog mode: G+0x2438 is a DWORD mode (SetFogMode sub_000373D0, renderer slot 73 +0x124, stores its dword arg; sub_0003AEB0 reads it; sub_0003B210 compares 1/2/3, cmp 3 at 0x3B295 -> push [0x4A28C0], call 0x4F930, then ecx = [edi+0x68] for the sky band upload); sub_0003B0A0 never reads +0x2438 (its compares are float on +0x2448/0x244C/0x245C). Feeder sub_00081350 maps env FogMode 0/1/2 -> vt+0x124(0/1/2); callers sub_001236D0, sub_00126A2A, sub_0016165A, sub_0020EC20; documented chain env FogMode (env+0xF8) -> 0x126A2A -> 0x81350 -> vt+0x124 -> [G+0x2438]; mode 3 (sky band) comes from elsewhere (12 other vt+0x124 sites unchecked). The byte init 0x80,0x80,0x80,0xFF at +0x2438.+0x243B is in sub_0003B3F0 (referenced only from slot +4 of table 0x45CCA0, not renderer vt 0x45C8A0) so its ECX is probably a different object (colour field). facts.fact: SkyFogOn does NOT gate SetSkyFogBand in the sky update sub_0012AA21: the only branch before `call [eax+0x144]` (0x12AAC7) is the sky-model-null early return (cmp [esi+0x94],0 / je 0x12AB0F). SkyFogOn loader: name lookup 0x130546, stored 0x13055C `mov [edi+0xE8], al` (catalog offset 232; 'offset 264' = 232 + 0x20 entity bias). Only literal reads of [envstate+0xE8] are MAEnvState secondary vtable 0x46FFC4 slots 0/1 = property save/load pair (slot 0 sub_0012FB98 read 0x12FE49 = save; slot 1 sub_00130290 read 0x13052A default, setne, store 0x13055C); callers of sub_0012AA21 (sub_0011CFA5 MACamera slot 50 +0xC8, sub_0011DD64 MAFreeCamera slot 46 +0xB8) gate on a hash lookup (sub_000B4F70) whose record matches the MASky2 singleton [0x4EB00C] (writer sub_003201C6), not SkyFogOn. => SkyFogOn appears round-trip only (loaded and saved, never consumed) on the code read so far (inferred; a table-driven getter would be missed; out-of-cluster +0xE8 readers 0x142A4F, 0x16C938, 0x20C171, 0x225A63 unowned). CATALOG FIX: SkyFogOn read_site 00130546 / write_site 0012FE5C do not match instructions (real: 0x13052A read + 0x13055C store in the loader; 0x12FE49 read in the saver). SetSkyFogBand sub_00037500 (recomp_0005.c:16373-16392): G+0x2498 = C/(B-T), +0x249C = -C*T/(B-T), +0x24A0 = 0, C = 1.0 (0x493A60); also stores T -> G+0x2450, B -> G+0x2454 (CORRECTION: not +0x2448/+0x244C; +0x2448 is only an init default at 0x3B755). Consumer sub_0003B210 (mode 3) calls sub_0040BF20 with edx = &G+0x2498, ecx = [edi+0x68]+0x60 appending a VS-constant record (0x41EA4 header, index ecx, 0x100B80, vec4): the sky band goes to c[b+0x60], right below the distance-fog constants c[b+0x61.0x63]; linear band f = (z-T)/(B-T). No MASky2 vtable method (0x46EA70) writes +0x1C4/+0x1C8 besides the ctor (recomp_0029.c:10864-10865); 0xE6A0E / 0xE49AF are not MASky2 writers (they touch +0x1CC and store vtables 0x467A5C / 0x467A54 and call D702D); 0xD2035 writes ebx+0x1A4/+0x1C4 with ebx unproven; other +0x1C4/+0x1C8 writers belong to MAEffect, MAMover/MAProjectile, MAMech, MATank, MACameraPan or are unowned (0xCC525, 0x101829, 0x101A42). So the runtime T=0.5/B=1.0 is NOT explained by a MASky2 writer: either the vt+0x144 receiver is not the fog object or level data supplies 0.5/1.0 through a loader not found yet; needs a runtime trace at 0x12AA21 entry (esi+0x1C4/+0x1C8) and the receiver's vtable (0x45C8A0?). Open: which coordinate the VS uses (world vs model y); who sets G+0x2438 = 3. facts.title: Culture level is sampled per texel inside sub_001801F6: L = T/(2^NBits-1) from the culture map; count = cellArea * Density * L * 1e-6

facts.title: Fog mode 3 = SHADOW pass (fixed 0.1 range on a VS fog coordinate), NOT the sky band; modes 2/3 identical; mode 1 uses G start/end

Mode 0 / other: 0x5C = 0 (fog off). The applier never reads G+0x2450/+0x2454 (sky band fields); its literal 3 is render-param key 0x5D, not a mode. facts.title: MAWpnGrp/MABarrel descriptors 0x4AED20/0x4AEA30 are class-registry blocks; MAWpnGrp loader 0xF1220 field map; game loaders use name strings, not CRCs
facts.fact: CORRECTION to the queue premise: 0x4AED20 (MAWpnGrp, XBE [0,-1,0,0xF0ECD]) and 0x4AEA30 (MABarrel, [0,-1,0,0xCC501]) are CLASS-REGISTRY blocks (create fn, name, parent 'MAEntity' via 0x4AED40 / 0x4AEA50), not CRC -> offset property tables. A dword scan of 0x400000-0x520000 for all 3398 catalog keys found 0 hits: CRC keys are a PC-side dictionary artifact; game loaders push NAME STRINGS. MABarrel: 0x4AEA30 is a 20-record class-descriptor registry (record 0: create 0xCC501, name 0x46624C, parent MAEntity, flag block (1, 1.0f)); slice: ctor 0xCC525, obj_size 0x22C, vt 0x465A68. Key formula confirmed: key = ~zlib.crc32(name) for 79/79 MABarrel slice names. MAWpnGrp ctor 0xF0EF1: vptr 0x468678 at +0, secondary 0x468670 at +0x20, 0x468668 at +0x24 (0xF0F01/0xF0F07/0xF0F0E) -> +0x20 bias on its loader. MAWpnGrp LOADER = 0xF1220 = slot 1 of secondary vtable 0x468670 (installed at obj+0x20 by the ctor, 0xF0F07); unload/release = 0xF1116 (slot 0) on the same 4 fields; 0xF0F81 is the deleting dtor; 0xF0FB6/0xF14B5/0xF14FB push no names. Map (name, string VA, disp -> object offset, store VA): BarrelTemplate 0x468774, 0x58 -> +0x78, 0xF1254; ProjectileTemplate 0x468760, 0x5C -> +0x7C, 0xF1281; WeaponFireClass 0x468750, 0x60 -> +0x80, 0xF12AE; WpnUpgradeLevel 0x468740, 0x78 -> +0x98, 0xF12E1. Each: read old [esi+disp], push name, reader vt+0xC (getter), convert via 0x33C10 or 0x33AF0, store; ends with call 0xC3AB0(reader) (entity-base property bag slot 1). 0x468670 = 0x468678 shifted back two slots; re_index lacks it (so loader searches by primary vt miss it). WeaponFireClass has no slice key block (name list only). Catalog: BarrelTemplate (B5645DDE, template ref -> MABarrel), ProjectileTemplate (4F51577D, -> MAProjectile), WpnUpgradeLevel (32D2BB1E, i32; slice says 3:i32 - wire type check open), and the weapon +0x78 bit-0x1 / +0x16C earlier facts concern MABarrel/MAWpnGrp objects: +0x78 on MAWpnGrp is BarrelTemplate (a template ref), so the '+0x78 bit 0x1' of weapon DEFINITION objects belongs to a different object (re-check). MABarrel serializer sub_000D364A (vt slot at 0x465AA0, shared by vts 0x465A68/0x465A60/0x465A58) emits 9 fields MEM32(edi+disp): 0x9C, 0x17C, 0x1C8, 0x1CC, 0x1D0, 0x1D4, 0x218, 0x21C, 0x220 (e.g. 0xD3722 push [edi+0x218], name 'beam object hit effect', helper 0xD3626); ctor 0xCC525 writes vts at +0, +0x20 (0x465A60), +0x24 (0x465A58) -> biased; catalog offset - 0x20 matches 8 of 9 stores. Effect map (catalog off / disp): Charging effect 0D720875 0x1E8/0x1C8; Fire effect 8FAA7193 0x19C/0x17C; Partial charge projectile 0553C419 0x1EC/0x1CC; Partial charge fire effect F5067C42 0x1F0/0x1D0; Fizzle effect FCC320E3 0x1F4/0x1D4; Beam end effect 163F3A4A 0x23C/0x21C; disp 0x218 = 'beam object hit effect' (780AD361 - catalog says 0xBC: CONFLICT; catalog 93B55E52 Beam terrain hit effect 0x238 clashes); disp 0x9C, 0x220 unnamed. obj_size 0x22C vs biased top store 0x240: conflict unless this = obj. DISPUTED: sub_000CC91C (no direct/data refs; indirect dispatch) handles 79 MABarrel names (77 match slice names): `mov esi,<name VA>; call 0x1A060` (build name), then `call [eax+0x14]` on edi with an ebp-relative frame record (records 0x90 apart; e.g. Damage ebp-0xBC8, Burst fire rate -0x628, Fire rate -0x598, Shots per burst -0xA18, Charge rate -0x358, Weapon class -0x1F0, Current ammo -0x6B8, Ammo capacity -0xC58, Splash damage -0x478, Direct hit damage -0xE08, Damage at minimum charge -0xB38, Fire effect -0xAA8) ending with push edi; ecx=ebx; call 0xC37D2 (entity-base property bag slot 0); no store through ebx. Earlier batches: archive vt+0x14 = PUT (save), vt+0xC = GET (load); so CC91C is likely a property registration / schema emitter or a saver, not the loader - UNRESOLVED. Rider logic: owner rider list = 12-byte entries [owner+0x1A8, owner+0x1AC), uid at entry+8: sub_000EB100 = count of entries with uid != 0; sub_000EAFD3(owner,1) = 1 if any rider's vt+0xA8 == owner's vt+0xA8 (same nation/team); sub_000EB056(owner,1) = 1 if any rider's vt+0xA8 differs (enemy rider); rider resolve sub_000EB16C(i): sub_000EB12B then sub_000B4F70 with ecx = owner+0x60. facts.title: Render-state cache G+0x18: 12-byte records, flush sub_3BC10 is GENERIC (not fog-only); key 0x52 -> NV2A method 0x1D78, not a D3DRS id
facts.fact: Record = T + key*12 (T = G+0x18, no stored key): +0 A-pending (written by sub_0003BA00 when value != +4), +4 committed, +8 B-pending (sub_0003BB80 unconditional); intrusive lists node = key+1: A head T+0x870, B head T+0xE18 (self-pointer = not queued). recomp_0006.c:6716-6774, 6933-6992; VA 0x3B310. B->A transfer sub_0003BF80; flush = sub_0003BC10 (A walker, only caller sub_0003B2F0 at 0x3B313; 36 callers of 3B2F0): pops A, +4 = +0, then by key: key < 0x5C -> push {header, value} to ring [0x4197C0] via sub_0040CF80 (overflow 0x40F7C0); keys 0x5C-0x87 -> OR mask into dirty word 0x41BC70; key >= 0x88 -> handler [0x4181A0 + key*4]. Order per renderer method: 0x3B3A0 -> 0x3BF80 -> 0x3BA00, then 0x3B2F0 -> 0x3BC10. Header table 0x45B0E0 (keys 0-0x5B) holds NV2A push headers (count 1<<18 | method): key 0x50 -> 0x334, 0x52 -> method 0x1D78, 0x53 -> 0x147C, 0x54-0x57 -> 0x1D90 (spot-checked XBE: 0x00040334/0x00041D78/0x0004147C). So key 0x52 is an NV097 method index, NOT a D3DRS id. ~80 / 12 callers of BA00/BB80; recomp_0070.c:2018 '0x52' is a dword COUNT, not a key. CORRECTION: t12_code_research.json:12399-12406 '0x3BC10 = fog-state flush' -> generic flush for all keys (fog is a subset). Generator ctor defaults (runtime = slice offset + 0x20; XBE floats checked, stores recomp_0039.c:32060-32087): Density +0x7C = 1000.0, MaxSlope +0x88 = 90.0, MinSlope +0x8C = 0.0, StartFade +0x90 = 200.0, StopFade +0x94 = 300.0, NearestNeighbor +0x98 = 0.0, GridScale +0xA4/+0xA8 = 10.0/10.0, SnapToGrid +0x82 = 0, +0xD4.+0xE8 = -300.0, +0x81 = 1, two 16-dword copies from 0x4B9CB0 into +0xEC / +0x12C; only fallbacks (all 46 retail generators carry every property). Full-dword copies: +0x270 (3205), +0x958.+0xBA4 (3456-3501). UPDATE the copy-state mask list: add +0x26C bit 3 (qword 35) and bit 22 (qword 54). Only dispatch found = sub_000B5930 (cdecl spawn-from-template helper: template T from registry K+0x24, class check vt+0x54, then S->vt[+0x40](T, flag)) at 0xB5994 (recomp_0018.c:30235); callers B4080 (spawn-tree visitor, bot spawn/respawn), B5B40, B4720, C63FA (MAPlayerConfiguration vt+0x38), E05AC (arm-debris callback, flag 1). So copy-state = initialise a spawned object from its template (inferred: no network-sync caller among the 5 checked). facts.title: sub_FF3FB: pilot-only bit 21->22->23 state chain on +0x268; two different 'bit 17' consumers (+0x26C pilot gate vs +0x268 read at 0xFF568); +0x80 bit 6 not +0x84
facts.fact: sub_000FF3FB (this=esi, returns state code): q = f1 / [P+0xBC] (P=[this+0x8C], f1 = vt slot 6 of [P+0x7C]; q=0 if divisor 0.0). |q| > 0.01 (0x493B44) -> code 1/2 (q >= 0) or 6/37 (q < 0) chosen by +0x268 bit 0; else f3 = vt slot 14 of [P+0x40]; |f3| < 1.0 -> 0 or 0x12. Bits 21/23 of dword +0x268 are cleared only when +0x26C bit 17 (IsPersonMech = pilot) is set: clear bit 21 (0xFF4C5) also sets bit 22 (0xFF4D3) -> return 0x1F; bit 22 set + bit 21 clear -> 0x20 (no write); clear bit 23 (0xFF514) only when bits 21/22 clear -> 0x21; non-pilot path 0xFF52D returns 0x15-0x17 (caller 0xFEED9) (inferred pilot-only chain). No catalog/wiki names exist for +0x268 bits 21/23; do NOT map t04_scenario.json:5170 0x200000/0x400000 names (MTB model node flags) onto this word. Bit-17 clarification: in FF3FB edx=[+0x26C], edi=[+0x268]; the pilot gate is ([+0x26C]>>17)&1, and loc_000FF568 tests edi & 0x20000 = dword +0x268 bit 17 (via register copy). CORRECTION: wiki.json items 67144 / 67383 ('no 0x20000 mask touches +0x268') are wrong; the no-code-setter verdict for that bit stands. Picker 0xFEED9 tests +0x26C bit 17 (0xFF210/0xFF2A6); copy-state merges +0x26C bit 17 and never touches +0x268 bit 17. IsPersonMech getter 0xFAB00 (catalog offset 620 = 0x26C). Two different 'bit 10' tests: 0xFF536 = +0x268 bit 10; picker 0xFF23A = +0x26C bit 10 (FreeTorsoRotation). +0x84/+0x80: MAMech slot 57 (0x10708D) sets +0x80 bit 6 (0x1070FC), slot 58 (0x107121, 1 arg) clears it (0x107152); CORRECTION candidate: t12_code_research.json:12679 '+0x84 . cleared by 0x103541' should read +0x80 bit 6. No immediate or/and/bt on [reg+0x84] with mask 4 anywhere in the XBE (3641 hits on +0x80/+0x84 scanned): the MAMech +0x84 bit 2 writer stays unknown (register-staged?); full stores of 4 to +0x84 only in Auto Menu Campaign Mission Picker (vt 0x48F3E0, 0x243B6E / 0x243DA5). Reads: slot 7 0xFC5C5 tests byte [esi+0x84]&4; 0xFD21D. +0x80 bit-2 clears at 0xFD350 (fn 0xFD300), 0x12CCC0, 0x12D828; store +0x80 = 4 at 0x1CD17F. sub_000DE8EF = MACorporeal slot 16, sub_000D7B3D = MACorporeal slot 11, no masks passed; sub_0010F06F = ctor-like init of a fresh 0x5E8 object.

facts.title: Rumble send chain 0x1FE60 -> 0x2B990 -> 0x41EE16 (stdcall, ~XInputSetState) -> 0x4210EF; IAT 0x4258B8 = RtlInitAnsiString (ordinal 289), not a file open
facts.fact: Chain 0x1FE60 -> sub_0002B990 (4 call sites; selects a 0x60-byte entry from table 0x4E4BC0 by port in ecx, NO bounds check; clamps to [0,1], scales x65535.0, stores u16 at entry+0x5C / +0x5E) -> sub_0041EE16(entry handle, entry+0x1A) (recomp_0003.c:24597) -> tail-call sub_004210EF (302 B, inferred transfer submit). sub_0041EE16 is stdcall (ret 8), not cdecl: returns 0x57 ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER if byte [[arg1+0xA3]+0x28] & 0x20; else zeroes arg2+0x40, writes a computed byte at arg2+0x41, tail-calls 0x4210EF (inferred = XInputSetState). MA2 hand-written src has no rumble output (XInputGetState for menus only); output lives in the xboxrecomp runtime: kit/source/game/src/usb/usb_gamepad.c usb_gamepad_output (6-byte report) -> xbox_InputSetState; kit/source/game/src/input/xinput_device.c line 498 '#else /* !_WIN32 */' so Windows compiles the host XInputSetState version (line 440), SDL_GameControllerRumble (line 591) is non-Windows. Consistent with wiki bots-rumble-port-guard (ports >= 4 overrun the 0x4E4BC0 table). Separately, XBE dword at 0x4258B8 = 0x80000121 = kernel ordinal 289 = RtlInitAnsiString (kit/source/game/src/kernel/kernel_bridge.c, kernel_thunks.c:274): the indirect call at 0x316BBC in save-path builder 0x316A7B initialises an ANSI_STRING over the built path, it is NOT the file open (neighbours 0x4258B4 = ordinal 16, 0x4258BC = ordinal 225). UPDATE 2026-10-24: the file open in 0x316A7B is NtCreateFile [0x425920] (save-meta-open-path-316a7b-ntcreatefile-modes-and-possible-bug). UPDATE 2026-10-24: the USB setup block and PC 6-byte report in rumble-usb-setreport-4210ef-setup-block-and-pc-6-byte-report.

facts.title: MAMech E+0x498 = time-moving accumulator (scaled frame dt), written by sub_FFA9A; sub_FFBD2 reads previous frame; +0x428/+0x42C foot records
facts.fact: E+0x498 is a time accumulator, not impact speed or fall height. Writer sub_000FFA9A (recomp_0025.c:19360-19399): len = sub_0019AA00(vec3 from an indirect call on [[E+0x8C]+0x40]); if len > 0, E+0x498 += double [0x4E2428] (0.0 in the image; the scaled frame dt published by sub_0001DE70, see game-time-scale-4a14f0-and-frame-dt-4e2428), else E+0x498 = 0.0. sub_000FFBD2 runs before the update, so it reads the previous frame's value. Inferred meaning: seconds spent moving (reset on zero speed, not on ground contact). Other writers: sub_000FAA65 (MAMech vt slot 1, fstp at 0xFBF86), sub_000F7E69 (footprint.mat function, movss at 0xF8064; also stores edi at +0x42C, candidate initializer). sub_00111D6C writes [esi+0x498] for MAFlyer (vt 0x46BC2C): the offset is class-specific. sub_000FFA9A calls sub_000FFBD2 twice: with [E+0x428], then with P = [E+0x42C]; 0xFFBD2 reads only +0xF4 (float) from that record. +0x42C writer sub_000F8793 (MAMech slot 11; strings bone_foot_print_r/l, rankle/lankle) -> inferred left/right foot records.

Readers: 0x1DF37, 0x1DDC4, 0x160E5D, 0x1C5E08 (plus unchecked 0x1DD47, 0x11D67F, 0x160ECD, 0x1C5DF7, 0x1C5E10). facts.title: MACultureType ctor sub_19CB99: size 0x88, three vtables, +0x78 Name, +0x84 descriptor pointer; no float defaults
facts.fact: Ctor sub_0019CB99 (alloc wrapper 0x19CB75, size 0x88) stores vtables 0x47A418 (+0x00), 0x47A40C (+0x20), 0x47A404 (+0x24); clears +0x84 (descriptor pointer = null); ORs 0x8 into +0x1C; calls base ctor 0xC3545 (shared with generator ctor 0x17ED88) and 0x1A020 on this+0x78 (empty string). No float defaults on the type. Documented: +0x78 = Name (slice offset 88, key 01EE2EC7; read 0x19CC61, write 0x19CC06) is the only own property. +0x84 is the culture-bitfield descriptor pointer, not a property. No BF index is stored on the type; the level is computed per texel from culture map 89FB5118 (u16): ((texel & mask) >> shift) / (2^NBits - 1). Documented: 46 types, 46 generators (parent MACultureSystem); the type->generator link mechanism is undocumented (inferred MoeEntity child/parent tree). Implication for the editor: a world needs a MACultureType with a matching Name AND a generator child for culture to appear; there is no name-only fallback and no type-level defaults.

facts.title: MACultureType vt slot 11 (0x19CC8F) sets +0x84 = sub_19CCF0(this): first-match case-insensitive NAME search of the Culture container; no match -> 0 (cell skipped)
facts.fact: MACultureType vt 0x47A418: slot 11 (+0x2C, 0x19CC8F) binds [this+0x84] = sub_0019CCF0(this) (store 0x19CC98); slot 16 (+0x40, 0x19CCB0) copies src+0x84 unless a flag byte is set (clones inherit); slot 13 (+0x34, 0x19CCA2) zeroes it. sub_0019CCF0 is a linear first-match search BY NAME: it gets the 'Culture' container (string 0x478428, via sub_000F7A55 from global [0x50C8E0]), walks items by index (sub_001899A1) and returns the first item with sub_00308616(this+0x78 Name, item[0]) == 0; no match -> 0 (level 0, the cell is skipped). Not by index, not by CRC key. Inferred: sub_00308616 is a case-insensitive compare, so 'Env_DeadBush' vs 'Env_Deadbush' still binds. CORRECTION: 0xF75BA / 0xF7797 are the terrain texture loop (nTextures, 'TextureName%d'), not the cultureBF key builder; the '%sBF%dName/Shift/NBits/Mask/Color0' formats are at 0x18DAD9 / 0x18DCC0 (inferred item fields Name +0, NBits +0xC, Mask +0x10, Shift +0x14). Settles the earlier 'Name->cultureBF link inferred' note: the link is by name, first match wins. CORRECTION 2026-10-24: [0x50C8E0] is the ACTIVE MATerrainInfo, not a 'Culture' container; the items are the terrain BF layers (maculturetype-slot11-corrected-bind-to-active-terraininfo-bf-layers).

facts.title: Dirty-word dispatcher sub_4110F0 full map; 0x4000 -> SET_SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM (0x1E70); 0xFF1000 group = lighting block 0x410B70; method 0x17C4 from key 0x8D
facts.fact: sub_004110F0 (recomp_0101.c:220583-220684) loads dirty word [0x41BC70] (ctx [0x41BC68]) and dispatches: 0x100 -> 0x40FA70; 0x800 -> 0x4161C0; 0xF -> 0x40FF50; 0x2000 -> 0x410150 (fog packet 0x2A0/0x29C/0x9C0); 0x400 -> 0x410340; 0x200 -> 0x410EE0; 0x4000 -> 0x40FBD0; any of 0xFF1000 -> 0x410B70. Store-back keeps only 0xC0000070. Callers 0x40E0D0, 0x40E790, 0x411180, 0x411330. The 0x4000 handler 0x40FBD0 emits method 0x1E70 = NV097_SET_SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM (repo NV2A header); key 0x88 (0x40CF50: [ctx+0x790] = arg, dirty |= 0x4000) -> inferred texture-shader stage program (payload path through edx at:217922 not fully traced). Group handler 0x410B70 is the lighting block: 0x294 LIGHT_CONTROL (0x10001 . 0x20001), 0x314 LIGHTING_ENABLE, 0x3B8 SPECULAR_ENABLE, 0x298 COLOR_MATERIAL, calls 0x410710 / 0x4108A0, and under edx & 0xFF8000 writes 0x3BC LIGHT_ENABLE_MASK (payload 0x7149F2CA at cursor+4, pairing inferred). 0x8000 is only consumed inside 0x410B70 (a lone 0x8000 never reaches it). Method 0x17C4 is written directly by the key 0x8D handler 0x40CEA0 (not on the dirty path) and is not in the repo headers; since 0x8D also sets 0x9000 (lighting group + light mask) and re-emits polygon mode, inferred lighting/two-sided related state. facts.title: IsNightTime (MAEnvironment +0x1C4): retail per-level values mostly unrecorded; only reader = MABuilding light update sub_127ED7 switching the LIGHTS node at +0x2B8
facts.fact: Documented: retail per-level IsNightTime is mostly unrecorded. says 1 in 34 worlds / 0 in 32 (default 1); the wiki says '1 in 34 of 60' (counts disagree). Bogged Down (Dusk02) retail value UNKNOWN (only our sample .wdf = 1; the Env_SkyDusk02_MP template is not placed in any retail world per audit.json:7896). Mission_10 UNKNOWN. Mission_02 = 1. facts.title: MATrigger fire path: sub_1452D4 and sub_14549F walk the +0x78.+0x7C list calling gate 0xB4F70; neither runs MAAction Execute; builder sub_145582 has a retail infinite-loop latent bug; recomp drops the loop
facts.fact: sub_001452D4 (fire) walks this+0x78.+0x7C (stride 4); per element calls gate 0x0B4F70 (ecx=[this+0x60]) , if nonzero, this->vt[+0xBC] on the trigger itself; the element (esi=[edi] at 0x1453EA) is never dereferenced. Fire also tests table byte 0x4EB9E0[eax] vs [this+0x94] (0x1453C3-0x1453CF; the wiki has MissionVariable at +0x90: reconcile). sub_0014549F = slot 47 (+0xBC) of all 19 MATrigger vtables; it re-walks the same list calling 0x0B4F70, then direct calls 0x199186 / 0x199199, and never calls vt+0x58. So neither walker runs MAAction Execute; the action runner is still unfound. MAAction vt 0x464DF0 slot 22 (+0x58) = 0x1A3459, a 3-byte stub shared by entity vtables 0x464C48 / 0x464F28, so it is not Execute. The 16 callers of 0x1452D4 are slot 7 (+0x1C, per-frame update) of MATrigger subclasses (0x1467B1 . 0x1A0094); others: 0x103D69, 0x14A7B1, 0x1D14A0, 0x1F2028, MAFreeCameraController slots 46/48 (0x1565B5, 0x156724). Builder/replace sub_00145582 (MATrigger slot 15, +0x3C), XBE bytes decoded at 0x145582: mov eax,[ecx+0x78]; cmp eax,[ecx+0x7C]; push esi; mov esi,[esp+0xC]; je 0x145599; mov edx,[eax]; L: cmp edx,[esp+8]; jne L; mov [eax],esi; call 0xB4420. The retail loop never advances (spins forever if the first element != arg1): a latent retail bug. RECOMP FIDELITY FLAG: generated sub_00145582 drops the empty-list `cmp eax,[ecx+0x7C]; je` AND the cmp/jne loop (loc_00145591 empty), so it always stores arg2 into [list.begin] even when the list is empty (begin may be null/stale); behaviour differs from retail (retail skips when empty, hangs on mismatch). Possibly a lost Jcc after cmp with [esp+disp] in the recompiler. The recompiled sub_00145582 is faithful to retail: it keeps the empty-list test (`cmp eax,[ecx+0x7C]; je loc_00145599` skips the store) and the non-advancing loop at loc_00145591 (`cmp edx,[esp+8]; jne loc_00145591`, hangs on mismatch like retail), then `mov [eax],esi` and the call to 0xB4420. The earlier reading probably came from a different tree (the the game source tree tree has no chunk 32 source). Only the retail latent infinite-loop bug stands; there is no recompiler defect here. Only two refs in recomp_0101.c: site A `call [esi*4+0x4181A0]` at 0x40E147 in sub_0040E0D0 (399 B; line 212827), site B `call [eax*4+0x4181A0]` at 0x40E405 in sub_0040E340 (628 B; line 213213). Both return early when value == shadow[key] at 0x41BC78+key*4. Keys < 0x5C go to the pushbuffer header table 0x45B0E0 via 0x40CF80; keys 0x5C-0x87 write the shadow and OR a dirty bit from table 0x45AEC0 into dirty word 0x41BC70; keys >= 0x88 call a handler. facts.title: The vertex program draws constants c[b+0x61.0x63]
facts.fact: The vertex program draws constants c[b+0x61.0x63]. Model program: c18=(-E/(E-S), -P/(P-Q)), c19=(-1/(E-S), 1/(P-Q)), c20=(-1,0,V2,1), eye world position in c17; terrain program: c24/c25/c26, eye in c27. oFog(o5) = clamp01((1 - min((E-d)/(E-S),1)) + max(min(t,1),0) x min(d/(P-Q),1)), where d = |world_pos - eye| (3D radial distance, NOT eye depth), t = (P-y_world)/(P-Q), S/E = FogStart/FogEnd (DD-scaled), P/Q = FogTop/FogBottom. Fog colour = lerp(col, FogColor, oFog) (0.1 fixed range per fog mode 2). So the height term fades in over the first (P-Q) m from the eye and is zero above FogTop; the distance and height terms ADD. Validated by emulating the dumped NV2A program per vertex: 556 vertices below the band matched the dumped out[12] within 0.003 (Deliverance, FogTop 7.5, FogBottom 0.9, S/E 200/500 at DD50); pilot-start terrain (y 7.5-9) correctly gets 0. Editor implementation: render.cpp fog_amt (branch fidelity 43c1b7d). UPDATE 2026-10-24: vertical FOV 33 deg and Mission_05 fog match in game-vertical-fov-33deg-and-mission05-fog-constants-match-editor.

facts.title: NV097: 0x328 SET_SKIN_MODE (key 0x89), 0x38C/0x390 SET_FRONT/BACK_POLYGON_MODE; 0x17C4 unnamed; PC D3D11 translator ignores all four; define conflict for cull face (0x39C vs 0x308) and shade mode
facts.fact: kit/source/game/src/nv2a/nv2a_regs.h, 1026, 1030: 0x0328 = NV097_SET_SKIN_MODE (0 OFF . 6 = 4 weights); 0x038C = SET_FRONT_POLYGON_MODE (0x1B00 POINT / 0x1B01 LINE / 0x1B02 FILL); 0x0390 = SET_BACK_POLYGON_MODE. So key 0x89 = skin mode (handler 0x40CF00); keys 0x8B/0x8C = front/back fill mode (0x40CE30 emits the pair, count 2). 0x17C4 (key 0x8D, handler 0x40CEA0, dirty |= 0x9000) has no name anywhere under src. The PC D3D11 pgraph translator ignores all four (no case in pgraph_d3d11_method, not in the default whitelist; nv2a_pgraph_d3d11.c:457/464/609-632): logged UNHANDLED and raw-stored in pgraph.regs[] (nv2a_core.c:551-568), so fill-mode writes never reach D3D11 (wireframe/point would not show; inferred, not tested). DEFINE CONFLICT nv2a_pgraph_d3d11.c:86/89 vs nv2a_regs.h: the translator defines SET_CULL_FACE_ENABLE = 0x039C (regs.h: 0x308 = CULL_FACE_ENABLE, 0x39C = SET_CULL_FACE front/back 0x404/0x405) and SET_SHADE_MODE = 0x0368 (regs.h: 0x37C). The case at:534 sets g_pg.cull_enable = (param != 0) from method 0x39C, so any cull-face write (0x404/0x405, always nonzero) enables culling and the real enable 0x308 is ignored; the whitelist comment at:620 also calls 0x39C TRANSFORM_PROGRAM_LOAD.

[rec+0x68] (0x189B6D-0x189BA3), skipped when count <= 0. No constant cap: the layer count is data-driven (retail data has cultureBF0-4). `add ebp,0x70` at 0x189BB2 hints at 0x70-byte records (inferred). sub_0018DAD9 formats '%sBF%d' + field and stores into the layer record: NBits +0x0C (0x18DB93), Mask +0x10 (0x18DBDE), Shift +0x14 (0x18DC29), Color0 4 bytes +0x18.+0x1B (0x18DC99-0x18DCA2), Name via helper 0x1A090 at the record base (+0x00 probable, inferred). facts.title: MAMech +0x268 bit 12: only setter sub_1045C6 at 0x10499C (mech not mounted); clears at 0xFF08D/0xFF0A5/0xFE746/0x102340/0x1049A5; FEED9 clear block 0xFF047 also entered when eax bit 17 clear
facts.fact: The only explicit setter is sub_001045C6 (jump-jet charge tick per wiki) at 0x10499C `or byte [ebx+0x269],0x10`, taken only if sub_000EB475 == 0 AND sub_001020D2(unit) == 0; else 0x1049A5 `and byte [ebx+0x269],0xEF` clears it. Caller sub_000FC4F2 (MAMech slot 7). sub_000EB475 is the mount check (compares the rider's mount with the mover), so bit 12 is set only when the mech is NOT mounted/carried (inferred). No dword or/bts/or-0x1000 on +0x268. Clears: sub_000FEED9 0xFF08D/0xFF0A5 (ebx = 0xFFFFEFFF from 0xFF04B), byte clears 0xFE746 (sub_000FE263), 0x102340 (sub_00102102 release), 0x1049A5. The FEED9 clear block 0xFF047 is ALSO entered when eax bit 17 is clear (0xFEFA9); the 0x1F-0x21 codes are one of two entries (amends event-codes-1f-20-21 fact). Testers: sub_000FF3FB 0xFF548 (`and ecx,0x1000` on the word stored at 0xFF51C; branch untraced); sub_00105EF2 0x106486 xor-copies the bit-12 diff into +0x26C (= StartJackedFallen bit); +0x26C bit 12 tested in sub_000FC4F2 0xFC53A (`je 0xFC552`) and sub_000FCA8C 0xFCA97. sub_001045C6 also writes bit 11 (burn; wiki fact jumpjet-charge-tick-sub-1045c6-burn-flag-0x800), so +0x268 bits 11/12 are jump-jet state bits (12 = inferred 'jets allowed / grounded'). facts.title: sub_FF60D is a pure leaf mapping P + +0x268 bits 28/29 to a code; sub_31D5C0 is the MAMech 64-bit flag-bit helper (NOT CRT); +0x26C bit 1 = getup in progress (set in sub_FE93C, cleared at state 0x18)
facts.fact: sub_000FF60D (0xFF60D-0xFF678) is a pure leaf (no calls/writes): input P (eax) + +0x268 bits 28/29 -> code: bit 28 set -> 0x0A (P=0 or 6), 0x13 (P=0x12), else 0x0B; else bit 29 set -> 0x0E / 0x14 / 0x0F in the same pattern; else P. Its +0x26C read is dead. Called at 0xFF061 (state 0x17, P=1), 0xFF079 (states 0x18/0x19, P=0) in loc_FF047 (from sub_FEED9 and sub_FEFDA), and from sub_FF3FB at 0xFF52F. Result -> [ebp-8]; only 0/1/6 reach the state 0x25/0x2 block at 0xFF115, others jump to 0xFF1AF. CORRECTION to the event-codes fact: sub_0031D5C0 is NOT a CRT function: it returns the 64-bit MAMech flag bit at index cl (0x31D5C0-0x31D5DE; +0x268 = bits 0-31, +0x26C = bits 32-63). Callers use cl=0x31 (IsPersonMech, +0x26C bit 17; set at 0xFE951) and cl=0x2A (FreeTorsoRotation, +0x26C bit 10; at 0xFF0D6); the functions.json 'crt' category for it is wrong. +0x26C bit 1 (64-bit bit 33): setter `or dword [esi+0x26c],2` at 0xFE9E1 in sub_000FE93C ('getup' routine), only if the getup vtable check at 0xFE9CA returns nonzero and +0x26C bit 2 is clear (0xFE99A); it also sets +0x268 bit 30 and float timer +0xA7C. Clearer `and dword [esi+0x26c],0xFFFFFFFD` at 0xFF0BD when state == 0x18. Whole-word writer `mov dword [esi+0x26c],2` at 0x235D68 in sub_00235C1B (class unknown). No tester found (no mask-2 test, no cl=0x21 call to 0x31D5C0 among 97 sites). Inferred: +0x26C bit 1 = 'getting up in progress'. CONFLICT (premise): sub_FE93C uses [this+0x98] as an object pointer (0xFE9B7-0xFE9CA) while sub_FF679 passes it to 0x18B62E, so the '+0x98 state' is a value derived from the +0x98 object (anim/state controller), not a plain int: read it as 'state = 0x18B62E(+0x98 object)'. facts.title: vt 0x45396C (D) -> 0x475F1C (B1) -> MoeWorldDatabase 0x4641D4; D is a single HEAP object (0x14C bytes) pointed to from 0x50CBB0, not contained in static composite 0x50CBA0; supersedes t12 ~8040

facts.title: APU HRTF model: HRIR taps are 8-bit signed (Q7, int8/128), 31 per ear: SET_HRIR 0x400 four taps/method (0-29), SET_HRIR_X 0x43C tap 30 + 16-bit ITD (s6p9 = value/512 samples, clamp +-42, fractional delay on one ear); entry select SET_CURRENT_HRTF_ENTRY 0x160 (128 entries); SET_VOICE_TAR_HRTF 0x31C copies taps+ITD to the voice; one FIR per 3D voice per frame (apu_vp.c:1232), no double filtering
facts.fact: clue for 'HRTF quiet': hrtf_filter target load divides each ear's taps by their L1 norm (apu_state.h:131-141), so every filter is <=1 gain and loses the HRIR's own gain; this is an emulator policy, not hardware behaviour, and is still present in the SHIPPING tree (the game source tree, apu_state.h:137 / apu_vp.c:1515-1517). Bins 0-3 are also divided by 1<<hrtf_headroom (apu_vp.c:1241, title register 0x280). Normalisation is a flat scalar, so the -14 dB ABOVE 4 kHz must come from table contents/Q7 rounding (inferred). Next test: disable L1 normalisation, apply headroom only, compare game-audio.wav. Root kit/source/game/src/apu still has two bugs fixed in the shipping tree: 3D bins use samples[b % channels] (bin 7 gets the left ear; shipping uses b>>1 for b<4), and `break` instead of `continue` skips the right ear when left L1 is 0 or 1; regenerating from root src would reintroduce both. Spot-checked kit/source/game/src/apu/apu_state.h, apu_vp.c:1245-1249.
facts.how_to_use: Open: whether disabling the L1 normalisation fixes the quiet HRTF mix.

facts.title: APU click sources (shipping tree = kit/source/game/src/apu; root kit/source/game/src/apu is an older copy): voice gains are computed ONCE per 32-sample frame (gains[b] = ea_value * attenuate(vol[b]) / headroom, apu_vp.c:1800) and applied flat across the frame: no per-sample ramp/lerp anywhere in apu/*.c; the envelope (EG) IS emulated per frame (voice_step_envelope apu_vp.c:1043-1050; DELAY/ATTACK/./RELEASE); but VOICE_OFF (voice_off 261-276) just clears ACTIVE_VOICE + posts notify and queues a converter reset (727, applied next frame 132-146), so a voice stopped without a release is cut instantly and the SRC_SINC_FASTEST tail is discarded; loop/segment wrap does NOT reset the resampler (src_reset only via voice_reset_filters at 664/700/727/736)
facts.fact: RANKED LEADS for quiet-passage clicks (inferred): (a) instant VOICE_OFF cut / discarded sinc tail -> add a short (32-64 sample) fade-out on voice_off; (b) per-frame gain steps on big volume changes -> lerp gains across the frame; (c) wrap (least likely). Test: RECOMP_APU_STREAM_TRACE + log the last sample value at each VOICE_OFF, then check game-audio.wav click timestamps. Spot-checked apu_vp.c:261-276 and 1794-1806.
facts.how_to_use: Open: whether the hardware CUR_VOL->TAR_VOL ramp (apu_vp.c:796-806) is emulated per frame.

facts.title: 0x40C050 = CreatePixelShader-shaped helper; owner of loc_0006FAE7 = sub_0006F8C0, ctor of the detail-blended terrain material; [esi+0x44] selects PS def 0x4A4760 (0) or 0x4A4940 (nonzero)
facts.fact: sub_0040C050 (recomp_0101.c:208020, cdecl 2 params): allocs 0xFC bytes (tag 0x24800000, via 0x12260; OOM -> 0x8007000E), sets +0/+4 refcounts to 1, copies 0x3C dwords (240 B, a D3DPIXELSHADERDEF) from arg1 into obj+0xC and stores the object pointer into *arg2; callers include 0x41E70, 0x6F8C0, 0x6F9FC, 0x6FFB0; 11 callers total. So 0x4A4760 / 0x4A4940 (and fog variants 0x4A4670 / 0x4A4850) are XBE DATA pixel-shader definitions. loc_0006FAE7 lies in sub_0006F8C0 (610 B, recomp_0011.c:16625; sub_0006F9FC is a second copy of its tail), the constructor of the detail-blended material (vtables 0x461360 family, wiki 'material_detail_blended'): it builds three texture/sampler objects at this+0x34/+0x38/+0x3C from descriptor slots +0x68/+0x80/+0x98 (five sampler setters each), sets this+0x40 = descriptor+0xB0 value, this+0x44 byte = 0, this+0x4C = PS handle (written by 0x40C050 via arg2 = &this+0x4C), then this+0x14 = (this+0x14 & ~0x100) | 0xC0. [this+0x44] selects the shader: 0 -> 0x4A4760 (TerrainDetailModulate 0), nonzero -> 0x4A4940 (Modulate 1); NOT a terrain-block marker.
facts.how_to_use: Open: that [this+0x44] mirrors the TerrainDetailModulate property is inferred (its setter was not read); the D3D name CreatePixelShader is inferred from the shape.
